4.130.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
bhagavankena tapasā vratena niyamena vā ..
dānena kena vā loke projjvaltvaṃ prajāyate .. 1 ..
4.130.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्केन तपसा व्रतेन नियमेन वा ॥
दानेन केन वा लोके प्रोज्ज्वल्त्वं प्रजायते ॥ 1 ॥
4.130.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / O Blessed One, by what austerity, by what vow, or by what observance, / or by what gift in this world does radiant splendour arise?

4.130.s:
atitejo mahaddīptaṃ dīptāṃśukiraṇojjvalam ..
śarīraṃ jāyate yena tanme vaktumathārhasi .. 2 ..
4.130.d:
अतितेजो महद्दीप्तं दीप्तांशुकिरणोज्ज्वलम् ॥
शरीरं जायते येन तन्मे वक्तुमथार्हसि ॥ 2 ॥
4.130.m: A body endowed with immense, blazing brilliance, radiant like the rays of the sun— / you ought to tell me that by which it is produced.

4.130.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mathurāyāṃ purā pārtha piṅgalo nāma tāpasaḥ ..
āgataḥ sa ca me patnyā jāmbavatyā prapūjitaḥ .. 3 ..
4.130.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
मथुरायां पुरा पार्थ पिङ्गलो नाम तापसः ॥
आगतः स च मे पत्न्या जाम्बवत्या प्रपूजितः ॥ 3 ॥
4.130.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In Mathurā formerly, O Pārtha, an ascetic named Piṅgala / arrived, and he was worshipped by my wife Jāmbavatī.

4.130.s:
praṣṭaśca praśramevaitaṃ sa cāvocadyathātatham ..
tayāpi me samākhyātaṃ tatsarvaṃ te vadāmyaham .. 4 ..
4.130.d:
प्रष्टश्च प्रश्रमेवैतं स चावोचद्यथातथम् ॥
तयापि मे समाख्यातं तत्सर्वं ते वदाम्यहम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.130.m: He was asked this very question, and he answered it truly; / she too related it all to me. I shall tell it to you.

4.130.s:
yadāyadā nṛpaśreṣṭha puṇyakālaḥ prapadyate ..
saṃkrātau sūryagrahaṇe candraparvaṇi vaidhṛtau .. 5 ..
4.130.d:
यदायदा नृपश्रेष्ठ पुण्यकालः प्रपद्यते ॥
संक्रातौ सूर्यग्रहणे चन्द्रपर्वणि वैधृतौ ॥ 5 ॥
4.130.m: Whenever, O best of kings, an auspicious time arrives: / at an equinox or solstice, a solar eclipse, a lunar junction, a Vaidhṛti yoga,

4.130.s:
uttare tvayane prāpte dakṣiṇe viṣuve tathā ..
ekādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ dinakṣaye .. 6 ..
4.130.d:
उत्तरे त्वयने प्राप्ते दक्षिणे विषुवे तथा ॥
एकादश्यां शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्दश्यां दिनक्षये ॥ 6 ॥
4.130.m: when the northern solstice or the southern has arrived, at the equinox likewise, / on an eleventh day of the bright fortnight, on a fourteenth day, on an omission of a lunar day,

4.130.s:
saptamyāmatha vāṣṭamyāṃ snātvā vrataparo naraḥ ..
nārī vā bhūmidevebhyaḥ prayacchetprayatāṃgaṇe ..
ghṛtakuṃbhena dīpena prajvalaṃtaṃ pradīpakam .. 7 ..
4.130.d:
सप्तम्यामथ वाष्टम्यां स्नात्वा व्रतपरो नरः ॥
नारी वा भूमिदेवेभ्यः प्रयच्छेत्प्रयतांगणे ॥
घृतकुंभेन दीपेन प्रज्वलंतं प्रदीपकम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.130.m: or on a seventh or eighth day, a man or woman dedicated to the vow, having bathed, / should give with self-restraint in a courtyard to the gods of the earth / a blazing lamp together with a pot of ghee.

4.130.s:
.. yudhiṣṭir uvāca .. ..
bhūmidevā iti proktaṃ yattvayā madhusūdana ..
kimetatkautukaṃ me'sti saṃśayaṃ chettumarhasi .. 8 ..
4.130.d:
॥ युधिष्टिर् उवाच ॥ ॥
भूमिदेवा इति प्रोक्तं यत्त्वया मधुसूदन ॥
किमेतत्कौतुकं मेऽस्ति संशयं छेत्तुमर्हसि ॥ 8 ॥
4.130.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / As to what was spoken by you, O Madhusūdana, namely, "the gods of the earth"— / what is this? I am curious; you should dispel my doubt.

4.130.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
purā kṛtayugasyādau triśaṃkurnāma pārthivaḥ ..
sa svargaṃ gantukāmo'bhūccharīreṇa narottama ..
tataścaṇḍālatāṃ nīto vaśiṣṭhena mahātmanā .. 9 ..
4.130.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पुरा कृतयुगस्यादौ त्रिशंकुर्नाम पार्थिवः ॥
स स्वर्गं गन्तुकामोऽभूच्छरीरेण नरोत्तम ॥
ततश्चण्डालतां नीतो वशिष्ठेन महात्मना ॥ 9 ॥
4.130.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Formerly, in the beginning of the Kṛta age, there was a king named Triśaṅku; / he wished to go to heaven in his physical body, O best of men. / Then he was reduced to the state of an outcaste by the great-souled Vasiṣṭha.

4.130.s:
triśaṃkuḥ sarvamācakhyau viśvāmitrāya dhīmate ..
so'pi manyuvaśādyajñaṃ cakārāhūya devatāḥ .. 4.130.10 ..
4.130.d:
त्रिशंकुः सर्वमाचख्यौ विश्वामित्राय धीमते ॥
सोऽपि मन्युवशाद्यज्ञं चकाराहूय देवताः ॥ 4.130.10 ॥
4.130.m: Triśaṅku reported everything to the wise Viśvāmitra; / he too, under the sway of wrath, performed a sacrifice having summoned the deities.

4.130.s:
na tā haviḥ pratyagṛhṇaṃstataḥ kruddhaḥ kuśātmajaḥ ..
viśvāmitrastu kopena cakārānyānsurottamān .. 11 ..
4.130.d:
न ता हविः प्रत्यगृह्णंस्ततः क्रुद्धः कुशात्मजः ॥
विश्वामित्रस्तु कोपेन चकारान्यान्सुरोत्तमान् ॥ 11 ॥
4.130.m: They did not accept the oblation; therefore, the descendant of Kuśa was enraged. / But Viśvāmitra in anger created other foremost gods,

4.130.s:
śṛṃgāṭakā nnālikerānpacanānānajauḍakān ..
medhārathadavārtākatārikūṣmaṇḍakodravān.. 12 ..
4.130.d:
शृंगाटका न्नालिकेरान्पचनानानजौडकान् ॥
मेधारथदवार्ताकतारिकूष्मण्डकोद्रवान्॥ 12 ॥
4.130.m: water caltrops, coconuts, [...], / [...], eggplants, [...], pumpkins, [and] kodo millets.

4.130.s:
uṣṭrānmanujadevāṃśca krodhānmuniravāsṛjat ..
cakārānyānsapta ṛṣīnpratimāsaṃ surottamān .. 13 ..
4.130.d:
उष्ट्रान्मनुजदेवांश्च क्रोधान्मुनिरवासृजत् ॥
चकारान्यान्सप्त ऋषीन्प्रतिमासं सुरोत्तमान् ॥ 13 ॥
4.130.m: In wrath the sage created camels and deities for men; / he created other seven sages, foremost gods for every month.

4.130.s:
tataḥ śakraḥ samāgamya viśvāmitraṃ prasādya vai ..
sṛṣṭiṃ nivārayāmāsa ye sṛṣṭāste tathāpi ca .. 14 ..
4.130.d:
ततः शक्रः समागम्य विश्वामित्रं प्रसाद्य वै ॥
सृष्टिं निवारयामास ये सृष्टास्ते तथापि च ॥ 14 ॥
4.130.m: Then Śakra, having approached and conciliated Viśvāmitra, / put a stop to the creation; yet those who were created remained as they were.

4.130.s:
martya loke ca te sarve devā devakuleṣvatha ..
maṃtrairnibaddhāḥ piṇḍīṣu sthitā mūrtibhṛto yathā ..15..
4.130.d:
मर्त्य लोके च ते सर्वे देवा देवकुलेष्वथ ॥
मंत्रैर्निबद्धाः पिण्डीषु स्थिता मूर्तिभृतो यथा ॥15॥
4.130.m: And in the mortal world all those gods, residing in temples, / bound to pedestals by mantras, stand like embodied forms.

4.130.s:
brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro ye cānye devatāgaṇāḥ ..
lokānāmupakārāya martyalokamupāgatāḥ .. 16 ..
4.130.d:
ब्रह्मा विष्णुस्तथा रुद्रो ये चान्ये देवतागणाः ॥
लोकानामुपकाराय मर्त्यलोकमुपागताः ॥ 16 ॥
4.130.m: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, likewise Rudra, and whatever other hosts of deities there are, / have come to the mortal world for the benefit of the worlds.

4.130.s:
pratimāsu sthitāḥ śaśvadbhogānbhuñjati śāśvatān ..
varapradāśca bhaktānāmiti te guhyamīritam .. 17 ...
4.130.d:
प्रतिमासु स्थिताः शश्वद्भोगान्भुञ्जति शाश्वतान् ॥
वरप्रदाश्च भक्तानामिति ते गुह्यमीरितम् ॥ 17 ॥।
4.130.m: Stationed in images, they perpetually enjoy perpetual offerings, / and they grant boons to devotees. Thus this secret has been declared to you.

4.130.s:
tebhyaḥ purastāddātavyo dīpyamānaḥ pradīpakaḥ ..
sūryāya raktavastreṇa pūrṇavartiṃ ghṛtairyutām ..
catuḥprasthaiḥ prajvalantīṃ maṃtreṇānena dāpayet .. 18 ..
4.130.d:
तेभ्यः पुरस्ताद्दातव्यो दीप्यमानः प्रदीपकः ॥
सूर्याय रक्तवस्त्रेण पूर्णवर्तिं घृतैर्युताम् ॥
चतुःप्रस्थैः प्रज्वलन्तीं मंत्रेणानेन दापयेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.130.m: Before them a blazing lamp should be given: / for Sūrya, one should cause to be offered with red cloth a full wick endowed with ghee, / blazing with four prasthas [of oil or ghee], with this mantra:

4.130.s:
tadvi ṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padaṃ sadā paśyaṃti sūrayaḥ ..
divīva cakṣurātatam .. 19 ..
4.130.d:
तद्वि ष्णोः परमं पदं सदा पश्यंति सूरयः ॥
दिवीव चक्षुराततम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.130.m: "That supreme step of Viṣṇu the patrons of sacrifice see perpetually, / like an eye stretched across the sky."

4.130.s:
pītavastreṇa kṛṣṇāya śvetavastreṇa śūline ..
kausuṃbhavastreṇāḍhyena gaurīmuddiśya dāpayet ..4.130.20 .. varti
4.130.d:
पीतवस्त्रेण कृष्णाय श्वेतवस्त्रेण शूलिने ॥
कौसुंभवस्त्रेणाढ्येन गौरीमुद्दिश्य दापयेत् ॥4.130.20 ॥ वर्ति
4.130.m: With a yellow cloth for Kṛṣṇa, with a white cloth for the Trident-bearer, / [and] intending Gaurī, one should offer [a wick] enriched with safflower-dyed cloth;

4.130.s:
lākṣāraktena durgāyai pūrṇavarti prabodhayet ..
nīlavastreṇa kāmāya gaṇanāthāya khādiraiḥ ..21..
4.130.d:
लाक्षारक्तेन दुर्गायै पूर्णवर्ति प्रबोधयेत् ॥
नीलवस्त्रेण कामाय गणनाथाय खादिरैः ॥21॥
4.130.m: with cloth red from lac one should ignite a full wick for Durgā; / with blue cloth for Kāma, [and] for Gaṇanātha with catechu-dyed cloth;

4.130.s:
nāgebhyaḥ kṛṣṇavastreṇa grahebhya iṣikā yudhām ..
devāṃganā pitṛbhyastu pitṛvartiṃ prabodhayet ..22..
4.130.d:
नागेभ्यः कृष्णवस्त्रेण ग्रहेभ्य इषिका युधाम् ॥
देवांगना पितृभ्यस्तु पितृवर्तिं प्रबोधयेत् ॥22॥
4.130.m: with black cloth for the Nāgas, with reed stalks for the planets [and gods of] weapons; / for the divine women, and for the ancestors one should ignite an ancestral wick.

4.130.s:
viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sūryāya pūrṇavartirnigadyate ..
śivāyeśvaravartīti bhogavartirjanārdane .. 23 ..
4.130.d:
विशेषं शृणु सूर्याय पूर्णवर्तिर्निगद्यते ॥
शिवायेश्वरवर्तीति भोगवर्तिर्जनार्दने ॥ 23 ॥
4.130.m: Hear the distinction: for Sūrya it is called a full wick; / for Śiva it is the Lord's wick, [and] the wick of enjoyment for Janārdana;

4.130.s:
padmavartirviriṃcāya gauryyai saubhāgyavartikā ..
nāgebhyo nāgavartīti grahavartiryudhiṣṭhira .. 24 ..
4.130.d:
पद्मवर्तिर्विरिंचाय गौर्य्यै सौभाग्यवर्तिका ॥
नागेभ्यो नागवर्तीति ग्रहवर्तिर्युधिष्ठिर ॥ 24 ॥
4.130.m: the lotus-wick for Viriñci, the auspicious-fortune wick for Gaurī; / for the Nāgas it is the serpent-wick, [and] the planetary wick [for the planets], O Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.130.s:
netrapaṭṭena madhunā ghṛtena madhukuṃḍake ..
arcite carcite caiva lalitāyai prabodhayet .. 25 ..
4.130.d:
नेत्रपट्टेन मधुना घृतेन मधुकुंडके ॥
अर्चिते चर्चिते चैव ललितायै प्रबोधयेत् ॥ 25 ॥
4.130.m: With fine silk, honey, and ghee, in a honey vessel, / worshipped and anointed, one should ignite [a wick] for Lalitā,

4.130.s: maṃtreṇānena rājendra tanniśāmaya vaidikam .. 26 ..
4.130.d: मंत्रेणानेन राजेन्द्र तन्निशामय वैदिकम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.130.m: with this Vedic mantra, O king of kings; listen to it:

4.130.s:
agre tvāṃ kāmyayā girā tubhyaṃ tā girasastu viśvāḥ ..
sukṣitayaḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. 27 ..
4.130.d:
अग्रे त्वां काम्यया गिरा तुभ्यं ता गिरसस्तु विश्वाः ॥
सुक्षितयः पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 27 ॥
4.130.m: "Before thee, with longing speech; may all those words be for thee, / peaceful dwellings, separately and distinctly.

4.130.s:
agne kāmāya jegire agnipriyeṣu dhāmasu ..
kāmo bhūtasya bhavyasya samrāḍeko virājati tābhyāṃ nāma svāhā .. .. 28 ..
4.130.d:
अग्ने कामाय जेगिरे अग्निप्रियेषु धामसु ॥
कामो भूतस्य भव्यस्य सम्राडेको विराजति ताभ्यां नाम स्वाहा ॥ ॥ 28 ॥
4.130.m: O Agni, they have sung out for desire in the abodes dear to Agni. / Kāma shines as the sole sovereign of what has been and what is to be. Svāhā unto both of them, indeed!"

4.130.s:
evametena vidhinā yaḥ prayacchati dīpakam ..
vistīrṇe vipule pātre ghṛtakumbhe niyojitam .. 29 ..
4.130.d:
एवमेतेन विधिना यः प्रयच्छति दीपकम् ॥
विस्तीर्णे विपुले पात्रे घृतकुम्भे नियोजितम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.130.m: Whoever in this manner, according to this rule, gives a lamp / placed in a broad, vast vessel [or] in a jar of ghee,

4.130.s:
yāṃti te brahmasadanaṃ vimānenārkavarcasā ..
tiṣṭhaṃti dyotamānāste yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam .. 4.130.30 ..
4.130.d:
यांति ते ब्रह्मसदनं विमानेनार्कवर्चसा ॥
तिष्ठंति द्योतमानास्ते यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ 4.130.30 ॥
4.130.m: they go to the abode of Brahmā in a celestial chariot radiant as the sun; / they remain shining there until the dissolution of all beings.

4.130.s:
sadīpe tu yathā deśe cakṣūṃṣi balavanti hi ..
tathā dīpasya dātāro bhavaṃti saphalekṣaṇāḥ.. .. 31 ..
4.130.d:
सदीपे तु यथा देशे चक्षूंषि बलवन्ति हि ॥
तथा दीपस्य दातारो भवंति सफलेक्षणाः॥ ॥ 31 ॥
4.130.m: Just as in a place endowed with a lamp, eyes are indeed powerful, / so those who give a lamp come to have fruitful sight.

4.130.s:
yathaivordhvaṃ gatirnityaṃ rājandīpaśikhāsu vai ..
dīpadātustathaivordhvaṃ gatirbhavati śobhanā .. 32 ..
4.130.d:
यथैवोर्ध्वं गतिर्नित्यं राजन्दीपशिखासु वै ॥
दीपदातुस्तथैवोर्ध्वं गतिर्भवति शोभना ॥ 32 ॥
4.130.m: Just as the upward course of the flames of a lamp is constant, O king, / so the beautiful course of the giver of a lamp is upward.

4.130.s:
ghṛtena dīpo dātavyo rājaṃstailena vā punaḥ ..
vasāmajjādibhirdeyo na tu dīpaḥ kathañcana .. 33 ..
4.130.d:
घृतेन दीपो दातव्यो राजंस्तैलेन वा पुनः ॥
वसामज्जादिभिर्देयो न तु दीपः कथञ्चन ॥ 33 ॥
4.130.m: A lamp should be given with ghee, O king, or else with oil; / but a lamp should never at all be given with fat, marrow, and the like.

4.130.s:
dīpastailena kartavyo na tu karma vijānatā ..
nirvāpaṇaṃ ca dīpasya hiṃsanaṃ ca vigarhitam .. 34 ..
4.130.d:
दीपस्तैलेन कर्तव्यो न तु कर्म विजानता ॥
निर्वापणं च दीपस्य हिंसनं च विगर्हितम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.130.m: A lamp should not be made with [impure] oil by one who knows the ritual; / and extinguishing a lamp or harming it is condemned.

4.130.s:
yaḥ kuryātkarmaṇā tena syādasau puṣpitekṣaṇaḥ ..
dīpahartā bhavatyaṃdhaḥ kāṇo nirvāpako bhavet .. 35 ..
4.130.d:
यः कुर्यात्कर्मणा तेन स्यादसौ पुष्पितेक्षणः ॥
दीपहर्ता भवत्यंधः काणो निर्वापको भवेत् ॥ 35 ॥
4.130.m: One who does so would become cataract-eyed by that deed; / a stealer of a lamp becomes blind, [and] an extinguisher becomes one-eyed.

4.130.s:
padmasūtrodbhavāṃ vartiṃ gaṃdhatailena dīpitām ..
virogaḥ subhagaścaiva dattvā bhavati mānavaḥ .. 36 ..
4.130.d:
पद्मसूत्रोद्भवां वर्तिं गंधतैलेन दीपिताम् ॥
विरोगः सुभगश्चैव दत्त्वा भवति मानवः ॥ 36 ॥
4.130.m: A person who gives a wick made from lotus fibres, / illuminated with fragrant oil, becomes free from disease and endowed with good fortune.

4.130.s:
prajvālya devadevasya karpūreṇa tu dīpakam ..
aśvamedhamavāpnoti kulaṃ caiva samuddharet.. 37 ..
4.130.d:
प्रज्वाल्य देवदेवस्य कर्पूरेण तु दीपकम् ॥
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्॥ 37 ॥
4.130.m: Having ignited a lamp with camphor for the god of gods, / one attains [the fruit of] an Aśvamedha and lifts up one's lineage.

4.130.s:
etanmayoktaṃ tava dīpadānaphalaṃ samagraṃ kuruvaṃśacandra ..
śrutvā yathāvatsatataṃ hi deyā dīpāstvayā viprasurālayeṣu .. 38 ..
4.130.d:
एतन्मयोक्तं तव दीपदानफलं समग्रं कुरुवंशचन्द्र ॥
श्रुत्वा यथावत्सततं हि देया दीपास्त्वया विप्रसुरालयेषु ॥ 38 ॥
4.130.m: This complete fruit of the gift of lamps has been spoken by me to you, O moon of the Kuru lineage; / having heard it properly, lamps should indeed constantly be given by you in the dwellings of brahmins and gods.

4.130.s:
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam ..
dīpadānāllalitayā yadavāptaṃ purā'nagha .. 39 ..
4.130.d:
अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ॥
दीपदानाल्ललितया यदवाप्तं पुराऽनघ ॥ 39 ॥
4.130.m: In this regard also they cite this ancient narrative, / what was attained in ancient times by Lalitā through the gift of a lamp, O sinless one.

4.130.s:
āsīccitrarathonāma vidarbheṣu mahīpatiḥ ..
tasya putraśataṃ rājño jajñe pañcadaśottaram .. 4.130.40 ..
4.130.d:
आसीच्चित्ररथोनाम विदर्भेषु महीपतिः ॥
तस्य पुत्रशतं राज्ञो जज्ञे पञ्चदशोत्तरम् ॥ 4.130.40 ॥
4.130.m: There was a king named Citraratha among the Vidarbhas; / to that king were born one hundred and fifteen sons.

4.130.s:
ekaiva kanyā tasyāsīllalitā nāma nāmataḥ ..
sarvalakṣaṇasampannā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi .. 41 ..
4.130.d:
एकैव कन्या तस्यासील्ललिता नाम नामतः ॥
सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्ना रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि ॥ 41 ॥
4.130.m: He had only one daughter, named Lalitā by name, / endowed with all auspicious marks, incomparable on earth in beauty.

4.130.s:
tāṃ dadau kāśirājāya cārvaṃgīṃ cārudharmaṇe ..
śatānyanyāni bhāryāṇāṃ trīṇyāsaṃścārudharmaṇaḥ .. 42 ..
4.130.d:
तां ददौ काशिराजाय चार्वंगीं चारुधर्मणे ॥
शतान्यन्यानि भार्याणां त्रीण्यासंश्चारुधर्मणः ॥ 42 ॥
4.130.m: He gave her, lovely of limb, to the king of Kāśi, Cārudharman; / Cārudharman had three hundred other wives.

4.130.s: tāsāṃ madhye'gramahiṣī lalitā sāpyathābhavat .. 43 ..
4.130.d: तासां मध्येऽग्रमहिषी ललिता साप्यथाभवत् ॥ 43 ॥
4.130.m: Among them, that Lalitā then became the chief queen.

4.130.s:
viṣṇorāyatane sā tu sahasraṃ paridīpakān ..
prajvālayantyanudinaṃ divārātramanirvṛtam.. 44 ..
4.130.d:
विष्णोरायतने सा तु सहस्रं परिदीपकान् ॥
प्रज्वालयन्त्यनुदिनं दिवारात्रमनिर्वृतम्॥ 44 ॥
4.130.m: She, however, in the temple of Viṣṇu lit a thousand lamps / every day, day and night without cessation.

4.130.s:
tāmisramāśvayukpakṣaṃ śuklapakṣaṃ ca kārttikam ..
tasyāḥ prajvalito dīpa uccasthānakṛtaḥ śubhaḥ .. 45 ..
4.130.d:
तामिस्रमाश्वयुक्पक्षं शुक्लपक्षं च कार्त्तिकम् ॥
तस्याः प्रज्वलितो दीप उच्चस्थानकृतः शुभः ॥ 45 ॥
4.130.m: During the dark fortnight of Āśvayuja and the bright fortnight of Kārttika, / an auspicious lamp was lit by her, placed in an elevated spot.

4.130.s:
tasminkāle tathā nityaṃ brāhmaṇāvasathe ca sā ..
vyagrā bhavati sāyāhne dīpapreṣaṇatatparā .. 46 ..
4.130.d:
तस्मिन्काले तथा नित्यं ब्राह्मणावसथे च सा ॥
व्यग्रा भवति सायाह्ने दीपप्रेषणतत्परा ॥ 46 ॥
4.130.m: At that time likewise, constantly in the dwelling of brahmins, she / became busied at dusk, intent on sending forth lamps,

4.130.s:
catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu devatāyataneṣu ca ..
caityavṛkṣeṣu goṣṭheṣu parvatānāṃ ca mūrddhasu .. 47 ..
4.130.d:
चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु देवतायतनेषु च ॥
चैत्यवृक्षेषु गोष्ठेषु पर्वतानां च मूर्द्धसु ॥ 47 ॥
4.130.m: At crossroads, on streets, in temples of deities, / at caitya trees, in cowpens, and upon the summits of mountains,

4.130.s:
pulineṣu nadīnāṃ ca kūpamūleṣu pāṃḍava ..
tāṃ sapatnyo'tha saṃgamya papracchuridamādṛtāḥ .. 48..
4.130.d:
पुलिनेषु नदीनां च कूपमूलेषु पांडव ॥
तां सपत्न्योऽथ संगम्य पप्रच्छुरिदमादृताः ॥ 48॥
4.130.m: And on the sandbanks of rivers, at the bases of wells, O Pāṇḍava. / Then her co-wives, having assembled, respectfully asked her this:

4.130.s:
lalite vada bhadraṃ te lalitaṃ vacanaṃ tathā ..
na tathā balipuṣpeṣu na tathā dvijapūjane .. 49 ..
4.130.d:
ललिते वद भद्रं ते ललितं वचनं तथा ॥
न तथा बलिपुष्पेषु न तथा द्विजपूजने ॥ 49 ॥
4.130.m: “Lalitā, speak charming words; may good fortune be yours! / Not so in offerings and flowers, not so in the worship of the twice-born,

4.130.s:
bhavatyāḥ sumahānyatno dīpaprajvālane yathā ..
tadetatkathayāsmākaṃ lalite kautukaṃ param .. 4.130.50 ..
4.130.d:
भवत्याः सुमहान्यत्नो दीपप्रज्वालने यथा ॥
तदेतत्कथयास्माकं ललिते कौतुकं परम् ॥ 4.130.50 ॥
4.130.m: Is your very great exertion, as it is in the lighting of lamps. / Therefore tell us this, O Lalitā; it is our supreme curiosity.

4.130.s:
manyāmahe tvayāvaśyaṃ dīpadānaphalaṃ śrutam..
.. lalitovāca .. ..
nāhaṃ matsariṇī bhadrā na ca rāgādidūṣitā .. 51 ..
4.130.d:
मन्यामहे त्वयावश्यं दीपदानफलं श्रुतम्॥
॥ ललितोवाच ॥ ॥
नाहं मत्सरिणी भद्रा न च रागादिदूषिता ॥ 51 ॥
4.130.m: We think that the fruit of the gift of lamps has certainly been heard by you.” / Lalitā said: / “I am not envious, good ladies, nor am I tainted by passion and the like.

4.130.s:
ekapatyāśritāḥ sādhvyo bhavatyo mama mānadāḥ ..
apṛthagdharmacaraṇāḥ śṛṇvantu gaditaṃ mama .. 52 ..
4.130.d:
एकपत्याश्रिताः साध्व्यो भवत्यो मम मानदाः ॥
अपृथग्धर्मचरणाः शृण्वन्तु गदितं मम ॥ 52 ॥
4.130.m: Devoted to one husband, virtuous, you are bestowaways of honour to me; / sharing the practice of the same duties, hear what is spoken by me.

4.130.s:
mayaitaddīpadānasya yatheṣṭaṃ bhujyate phalam ..
hiraṇyadayitā bhāryā śailarājasutā varā .. 53 ..
4.130.d:
मयैतद्दीपदानस्य यथेष्टं भुज्यते फलम् ॥
हिरण्यदयिता भार्या शैलराजसुता वरा ॥ 53 ॥
4.130.m: By me this fruit of the gift of lamps is enjoyed as desired. / The beloved wife of Śiva, the excellent daughter of the mountain king,

4.130.s:
umādevīti madreṣu devikā sā saridvarā ..
narāṇāmanukampārthaṃ brahmaṇā hyavatāritā ..
śrutā kiṃ bhavatībhiḥ sā devikā pāpanāśinī .. 54 ..
4.130.d:
उमादेवीति मद्रेषु देविका सा सरिद्वरा ॥
नराणामनुकम्पार्थं ब्रह्मणा ह्यवतारिता ॥
श्रुता किं भवतीभिः सा देविका पापनाशिनी ॥ 54 ॥
4.130.m: Goddess Umā; in the Madra country, that excellent river Devikā / was brought down indeed by Brahmā for the sake of compassion toward men: / has that sin-destroying Devikā been heard of by you?

4.130.s:
tasyāṃ snātvā sakṛnnadyāṃ gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt..
tasyāmatha nṛsiṃhākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ kalmaṣanāśanam ..
hariṇā nṛsiṃhavapuṣā yatra snānaṃ kṛtaṃ purā .. 55..
4.130.d:
तस्यां स्नात्वा सकृन्नद्यां गाणपत्यमवाप्नुयात्॥
तस्यामथ नृसिंहाख्यं तीर्थं कल्मषनाशनम् ॥
हरिणा नृसिंहवपुषा यत्र स्नानं कृतं पुरा ॥ 55॥
4.130.m: Having bathed once in that river, one may obtain the status of a gaṇa-chief. / Upon it there is a sacred bathing place named Nṛsiṃha, destroyer of sins, / where bathing was performed in ancient times by Hari in the form of Nṛsiṃha.

4.130.s:
sauvīrarājasya purā maitreyobhūtpurohitaḥ ..
tena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kāritaṃ devikātaṭe .. 56 ..
4.130.d:
सौवीरराजस्य पुरा मैत्रेयोभूत्पुरोहितः ॥
तेन चायतनं विष्णोः कारितं देविकातटे ॥ 56 ॥
4.130.m: In ancient times there was a family priest of the king of Sauvīra named Maitreya; / and by him a temple of Viṣṇu was caused to be built on the bank of the Devikā.

4.130.s:
ahanyahani śuśrūṣāṃ puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ..
dīpadānādibhiścaiva cakre tatra sa vai dvijaḥ .. 57 ..
4.130.d:
अहन्यहनि शुश्रूषां पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः ॥
दीपदानादिभिश्चैव चक्रे तत्र स वै द्विजः ॥ 57 ॥
4.130.m: Day after day that twice-born indeed performed service there / with flowers, incense, ointments, and with gifts of lamps and the like.

4.130.s:
kārttikyāṃ dīpakastatra pradattastena caikadā ..
āsīnnirvāṇabhūyiṣṭho devārcāsu rato niśi .. 58 ..
4.130.d:
कार्त्तिक्यां दीपकस्तत्र प्रदत्तस्तेन चैकदा ॥
आसीन्निर्वाणभूयिष्ठो देवार्चासु रतो निशि ॥ 58 ॥
4.130.m: On the full-moon day of Kārttika, a lamp was offered there by him; / devoted to the rites of the deity at night, it had almost gone out.

4.130.s:
devatāyatane'vātsaṃ tatrāhamapi mūṣikā ..
pradīpavartiharaṇe kṛtabuddhirvarānanāḥ .. 59 ..
4.130.d:
देवतायतनेऽवात्सं तत्राहमपि मूषिका ॥
प्रदीपवर्तिहरणे कृतबुद्धिर्वराननाः ॥ 59 ॥
4.130.m: I also was dwelling there in the temple of the deity as a female mouse, / having resolved on taking away the lamp-wick, O fair-faced ones.

4.130.s:
gṛhītātha mayā vartirvṛkadaṃśo rarāsa ca ..
naṣṭā cāhaṃ tatastasya mārjārasya bhayāturā .. 4.130.60 ..
4.130.d:
गृहीताथ मया वर्तिर्वृकदंशो ररास च ॥
नष्टा चाहं ततस्तस्य मार्जारस्य भयातुरा ॥ 4.130.60 ॥
4.130.m: Then the wick was seized by me, and a cat cried out; / and then I fled, distressed with fear of that cat.

4.130.s:
vaktraprāṃtena paśyaṃtyā sa dīpaḥ prerito mayā ..
jajvāla pūrvavaddīptyā tasminnāyatane punaḥ .. 61 ..
4.130.d:
वक्त्रप्रांतेन पश्यंत्या स दीपः प्रेरितो मया ॥
जज्वाल पूर्ववद्दीप्त्या तस्मिन्नायतने पुनः ॥ 61 ॥
4.130.m: As I was looking with the side of my mouth, that lamp was stirred by me; / it blazed again in that temple with radiance as before.

4.130.s:
mṛtāhaṃ ca punarjātā vaidarbhe rājakanyakā ..
jātismarā mahīpasya mahiṣī cārudharmaṇaḥ .. 62 ..
4.130.d:
मृताहं च पुनर्जाता वैदर्भे राजकन्यका ॥
जातिस्मरा महीपस्य महिषी चारुधर्मणः ॥ 62 ॥
4.130.m: And I died, and was born again as a royal princess in Vidarbha, / remembering past lives, the queen of King Cārudharman.

4.130.s:
eṣa prabhāvo dīpasya kārttike māsi śobhanaḥ ..
dattasyāyatane viṣṇo ryasyeyaṃ vyuṣṭiruttamā .. 63 ..
4.130.d:
एष प्रभावो दीपस्य कार्त्तिके मासि शोभनः ॥
दत्तस्यायतने विष्णो र्यस्येयं व्युष्टिरुत्तमा ॥ 63 ॥
4.130.m: Such is the auspicious power of a lamp in the month of Kārttika / offered in a temple of Viṣṇu, whose highest result is this.

4.130.s:
asaṃkalpitamadhyasya preraṇaṃ yanmayā kṛtam ..
keśave bāladīpasya tasyedaṃ bhujyate phalam .. 64 ..
4.130.d:
असंकल्पितमध्यस्य प्रेरणं यन्मया कृतम् ॥
केशवे बालदीपस्य तस्येदं भुज्यते फलम् ॥ 64 ॥
4.130.m: Because stirring of the lamp, unintended, was done by me / in the middle [of the sanctuary] unto Keśava, this fruit of the newly kindled lamp is enjoyed.

4.130.s:
etasmātkāra ṇāddīpānahametānaharniśam ..
prayacchāmi harergehe jātamasya mahāphalam .. 65..
4.130.d:
एतस्मात्कार णाद्दीपानहमेतानहर्निशम् ॥
प्रयच्छामि हरेर्गेहे जातमस्य महाफलम् ॥ 65॥
4.130.m: For this reason, day and night, I offer / these lamps in the house of Hari; its great fruit has arisen.”

4.130.s:
evamuktvā sapatnīḥ sā dīpadānaparāyaṇā ..
babhūva devadevasya keśava sya gṛhe sadā .. 66 ..
4.130.d:
एवमुक्त्वा सपत्नीः सा दीपदानपरायणा ॥
बभूव देवदेवस्य केशव स्य गृहे सदा ॥ 66 ॥
4.130.m: Having spoken thus to her co-wives, she remained devoted to the gift of lamps / in the house of Keśava, the god of gods, constantly.

4.130.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā saha rājñā mahātmanā ..
viṣṇulokamanuprāptā paṃcatvaṃ prāya mānadā .. 67 ..
4.130.d:
ततः कालेन महता सह राज्ञा महात्मना ॥
विष्णुलोकमनुप्राप्ता पंचत्वं प्राय मानदा ॥ 67 ॥
4.130.m: Then after a long time, together with the high-souled king, / having attained dissolution into the five elements, she, bestowaway of honour, reached the world of Viṣṇu.

4.130.s:
taṃ lokamāsādya nṛpeṇa sārddhaṃ sā rājapatnī kamalābhanetrā ..
reme mahīpālamudā sametā dīpapradānātsakalārtihīnā .. 68 ..
4.130.d:
तं लोकमासाद्य नृपेण सार्द्धं सा राजपत्नी कमलाभनेत्रा ॥
रेमे महीपालमुदा समेता दीपप्रदानात्सकलार्तिहीना ॥ 68 ॥
4.130.m: Having reached that world together with the king, that royal consort with eyes like a lotus / rejoiced in company with the joy of the king, free of all distress on account of the gift of lamps.

4.130.s:
dīpapradānamapi puṇyataraṃ vadaṃti viprāgnigosurakulaikagṛhāṃgaṇeṣu ..
taddānadīptavapuṣātha pathoṃdhakāre gacchannaraḥ patati na skhalate kadācit .. 69 ..
vṛṣotsargavidhivarṇanam
4.130.d:
दीपप्रदानमपि पुण्यतरं वदंति विप्राग्निगोसुरकुलैकगृहांगणेषु ॥
तद्दानदीप्तवपुषाथ पथोंधकारे गच्छन्नरः पतति न स्खलते कदाचित् ॥ 69 ॥
वृषोत्सर्गविधिवर्णनम्
4.130.m:
They declare the gift of a lamp to be exceedingly meritorious also in the single courtyard of a house of brahmins, fire, cows, or gods; / then, with his body illuminated by that gift, a man walking on a path in the darkness never falls or stumbles.
Description of the rules for the setting free of a bull

4.131.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kārttikyāmatha vā māghyāmayameva yudhiṣṭhira .. 1 ..
4.131.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
कार्त्तिक्यामथ वा माघ्यामयमेव युधिष्ठिर ॥ 1 ॥
4.131.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “On the full-moon day of Kārttika, or on the full-moon day of Māgha, Yudhiṣṭhira,

4.131.s:
caitryāmatha tṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ dvādaśe'hni vā ..
khaṃḍanīlaṃ śaṃkhapādaṃ sapauṃḍraṃ dhautapuṣpakam .. 2 ..
4.131.d:
चैत्र्यामथ तृतीयायां वैशाख्यां द्वादशेऽह्नि वा ॥
खंडनीलं शंखपादं सपौंड्रं धौतपुष्पकम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.131.m: Or on the third lunar day of the full-moon day of Caitra, or on the twelfth day of the month of Vaiśākha, / one should release [a bull] that is dark blue in parts, white-hoofed, marked with a puṇḍra, pure-spotted,

4.131.s:
gobhiścaturbhiḥ sahitaṃ sṛjeccaiva vidhiṃ śṛṇu ..
yaduvāca purā gargo gokule'nagha pāṃḍava .. 3 ..
4.131.d:
गोभिश्चतुर्भिः सहितं सृजेच्चैव विधिं शृणु ॥
यदुवाच पुरा गर्गो गोकुलेऽनघ पांडव ॥ 3 ॥
4.131.m: Together with four cows; hear the procedure indeed / which Garga declared in Gokula in ancient times, O sinless Pāṇḍava.

4.131.s:
tattehaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ gargapracoditam .. .
mātaraṃ sthāpayitvāgre pūjayetkusumākṣataiḥ .. 4 ..
4.131.d:
तत्तेहं च प्रवक्ष्यामि विधिं गर्गप्रचोदितम् ॥ ।
मातरं स्थापयित्वाग्रे पूजयेत्कुसुमाक्षतैः ॥ 4 ॥
4.131.m: I shall also tell you that procedure enjoined by Garga. / Having placed the mother in front, one should worship her with flowers and unbroken rice grains.

4.131.s:
mātṛśrāddhaṃ tataḥ kuryātsadābhyudayakārakam ..
akālamūlaṃ kalaśamaśvatthadalaśobhitam .. 5 ..
4.131.d:
मातृश्राद्धं ततः कुर्यात्सदाभ्युदयकारकम् ॥
अकालमूलं कलशमश्वत्थदलशोभितम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.131.m: Then one should perform the ancestral offering to mothers, which always causes prosperity. / [Taking] an unblackened pot adorned with leaves of the sacred fig tree,

4.131.s:
tatra vidvāñjapitvā tu sthāpayedrudradevatām ..
susamiddhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vahnimaṃtrapuraḥsaram .. 6 ..
4.131.d:
तत्र विद्वाञ्जपित्वा तु स्थापयेद्रुद्रदेवताम् ॥
सुसमिद्धं ततः कृत्वा वह्निमंत्रपुरःसरम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.131.m: Having chanted prayers there, the wise man should establish the deity Rudra; / then, having made the fire blaze well, preceded by mantras,

4.131.s:
athainaṃ juhuyātṣaḍbhiḥ pṛthagāhutisaṃjñitaiḥ ..
pauṣyāmaṃtraistataḥ paścāddhutvā vahniṃ yathāvidhi .. 7 ..
4.131.d:
अथैनं जुहुयात्षड्भिः पृथगाहुतिसंज्ञितैः ॥
पौष्यामंत्रैस्ततः पश्चाद्धुत्वा वह्निं यथाविधि ॥ 7 ॥
4.131.m: Then one should offer into it with six distinct oblations known by name / with Pauṣya mantras; having offered into the fire according to rule thereafter,

4.131.s:
ekavarṇaṃ dvivarṇaṃ vā rohitaṃ śvetameva vā ..
jīvadvatsapayasvinyāḥ 'nnaṃ sarvāṃgasundaram .. 8 ..
4.131.d:
एकवर्णं द्विवर्णं वा रोहितं श्वेतमेव वा ॥
जीवद्वत्सपयस्विन्याः ऽन्नं सर्वांगसुन्दरम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.131.m: A [bull] of one colour or of two colours, or red, or white, / offspring of a milk-giving cow whose calf is living, handsome in all limbs,

4.131.s:
catasro vatsataryaśca tābhiḥ sārdha malaṃkṛtam..
tāsāṃ karṇe japedvipraḥ patiṃ vo balinaṃ śubham .. 9 ..
4.131.d:
चतस्रो वत्सतर्यश्च ताभिः सार्ध मलंकृतम्॥
तासां कर्णे जपेद्विप्रः पतिं वो बलिनं शुभम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.131.m: And four young heifers; adorned together with them, / into their ears the twice-born should whisper: ‘A strong, auspicious husband for you

4.131.s:
samitāstena sahitāḥ krīḍadhvaṃ hṛṣṭamānasāḥ ..
tato vāme triśūlaṃ ca dakṣiṇe cakramālikhet.. 4.131.10 ..
4.131.d:
समितास्तेन सहिताः क्रीडध्वं हृष्टमानसाः ॥
ततो वामे त्रिशूलं च दक्षिणे चक्रमालिखेत्॥ 4.131.10 ॥
4.131.m: Has come; together with him, sport with gladdened minds!’ / Then on the left flank one should mark a trident, and on the right a discus.

4.131.s:
aṃkitaṃ śaṃkhacakrābhyāṃ varṣitaṃ kusumādinā..
puṣpamālākṛtagrīvaṃ sitavastraiśca cchāditam .. 11 ..
4.131.d:
अंकितं शंखचक्राभ्यां वर्षितं कुसुमादिना॥
पुष्पमालाकृतग्रीवं सितवस्त्रैश्च च्छादितम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.131.m: Marked with a conch and discus, showered with flowers and the like, / with a garland of flowers placed around its neck, and covered with white garments,

4.131.s:
vimuṃcedvatsakābhiśca nīlābhirbalinaṃ vṛṣam ..
devālaye gokule vā nadīnāṃ saṃgame'tha vā .. 12 ..
4.131.d:
विमुंचेद्वत्सकाभिश्च नीलाभिर्बलिनं वृषम् ॥
देवालये गोकुले वा नदीनां संगमेऽथ वा ॥ 12 ॥
4.131.m: one should release the strong bull together with dark heifers / at a temple, in a cow-pen, or at the confluence of rivers.

4.131.s:
ityukte gargamuninā vidhānaṃ vṛṣamokṣaṇe ..
svecchāvihāriṇaṃ dṛptaṃ garjaṃtaṃ sundaraṃ gavām .. 13 ..
4.131.d:
इत्युक्ते गर्गमुनिना विधानं वृषमोक्षणे ॥
स्वेच्छाविहारिणं दृप्तं गर्जंतं सुन्दरं गवाम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.131.m: Thus the procedure for releasing a bull was proclaimed by the sage Garga. / Those fortunate women who release a bull, the lord of cows,

4.131.s:
kakudminaṃ patiṃ yā dhanye vimuñcanti govṛṣam ..
phalaṃ ca tasya vakṣyāmi bruvatāṃ me nibodha tat .. 14 ..
4.131.d:
ककुद्मिनं पतिं या धन्ये विमुञ्चन्ति गोवृषम् ॥
फलं च तस्य वक्ष्यामि ब्रुवतां मे निबोध तत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.131.m: wandering at its own will, proud, bellowing, handsome, / and humped—I shall tell you its fruit; listen as I declare it.

4.131.s:
vṛṣotsarge punātyeva daśātītāndaśāparān ..
yatkiṃcitspṛśate toyaṃ samuttīrya jalānmahīm .. 15 ..
4.131.d:
वृषोत्सर्गे पुनात्येव दशातीतान्दशापरान् ॥
यत्किंचित्स्पृशते तोयं समुत्तीर्य जलान्महीम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.131.m: In the rite of releasing a bull, he indeed purifies ten ancestors and ten descendants. / Whatever water it touches, emerging from the water onto the earth,

4.131.s:
vṛṣotsṛṣṭaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu tadakṣayamudāhṛtam ..
yaiśca yaiśca spṛśettoyaṃ lāṃgūlādibhiraṃtataḥ .. 16 ..
4.131.d:
वृषोत्सृष्टं पितॄणां तु तदक्षयमुदाहृतम् ॥
यैश्च यैश्च स्पृशेत्तोयं लांगूलादिभिरंततः ॥ 16 ॥
4.131.m: touched by the released bull, is declared imperishable for the ancestors. / And whatever water it touches with its tail and other limbs at last,

4.131.s:
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ tasya pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
śṛṅgaiḥ khurairvā yadbhūmimullikhatyaniśaṃ vṛṣaḥ .. 17 ..
4.131.d:
सर्वं तदक्षयं तस्य पितॄणां नात्र संशयः ॥
शृङ्गैः खुरैर्वा यद्भूमिमुल्लिखत्यनिशं वृषः ॥ 17 ॥
4.131.m: all that becomes imperishable for his ancestors; of this there is no doubt. / Whatever ground the bull constantly scratches up with its horns or hooves,

4.131.s:
madhukulyāḥ pitustasya akṣayāstā bhavaṃti vai ..
sahasratalamātreṇa taḍāgo na yathāśruti .. 18 ..
4.131.d:
मधुकुल्याः पितुस्तस्य अक्षयास्ता भवंति वै ॥
सहस्रतलमात्रेण तडागो न यथाश्रुति ॥ 18 ॥
4.131.m: those become imperishable streams of honey for his father. / Even by a tank having an extent of a thousand talas, as stated in the traditional texts,

4.131.s:
pitṝṇāṃ yā bhavettṛptistāṃ vṛṣastvatiricyate ..
yo dadāti tilairmiśrāṃstilānvā śrāddhakarmaṇi..
madhu vā nīlakhaṃḍaṃ vā akṣayaṃ sarvameva tat..19..
4.131.d:
पितॄणां या भवेत्तृप्तिस्तां वृषस्त्वतिरिच्यते ॥
यो ददाति तिलैर्मिश्रांस्तिलान्वा श्राद्धकर्मणि॥
मधु वा नीलखंडं वा अक्षयं सर्वमेव तत्॥19॥
4.131.m: the satisfaction that would accrue to the ancestors, the bull surpasses even that. / He who gives [water] mixed with sesame seeds, or sesame seeds in the rite of śrāddha, / or honey, or dark sugar-candy—all of that is indeed imperishable.

4.131.s:
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyeko'pi gayāṃ vrajet..
yajeta vāśvamedhena nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet..4.131.20..
4.131.d:
एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा यद्येकोऽपि गयां व्रजेत्॥
यजेत वाश्वमेधेन नीलं वा वृषमुत्सृजेत्॥4.131.20॥
4.131.m: Many sons should be desired, so that if even one goes to Gayā, / or performs an aśvamedha, or releases a dark bull.

4.131.s:
na karoti vṛṣotsargaṃ sutīrthe vā jalāñjalim..
na prayacchati yaḥ putraḥ pituruccāra eva saḥ..21..
4.131.d:
न करोति वृषोत्सर्गं सुतीर्थे वा जलाञ्जलिम्॥
न प्रयच्छति यः पुत्रः पितुरुच्चार एव सः॥21॥
4.131.m: A son who does not perform the release of a bull, nor gives a handful of water / at an auspicious sacred ford, is mere excrement of his father.

4.131.s:
yadbhūmimālikhati śṛṅgakhuraiḥ prahṛṣṭo yadvā karoti pratimallavṛṣānnirīkṣya.
khaṇḍaṃ samastamapi tasya vivāhakartuḥ saṃtoṣamāvahati śakrasabhāgatasya..22..
phālgunapūrṇimāvratavarṇanam
4.131.d:
यद्भूमिमालिखति शृङ्गखुरैः प्रहृष्टो यद्वा करोति प्रतिमल्लवृषान्निरीक्ष्य।
खण्डं समस्तमपि तस्य विवाहकर्तुः संतोषमावहति शक्रसभागतस्य॥22॥
फाल्गुनपूर्णिमाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.131.m:
Whatever ground he scratches up with his horns and hooves when delighted, or whatever piece he breaks seeing rival bulls, / all of that brings complete satisfaction to the performer of his marriage when he has reached the assembly of Śakra.
Description of the Vow on the Full Moon of Phālguna

4.132.s:
..yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kimarthaṃ phālgunasyāṃte paurṇamāsyāṃ janārdana ..
utsavo jāyate loke grāmegrāme pure pure.. 1 ..
4.132.d:
॥युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
किमर्थं फाल्गुनस्यांते पौर्णमास्यां जनार्दन ॥
उत्सवो जायते लोके ग्रामेग्रामे पुरे पुरे॥ 1 ॥
4.132.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / For what purpose, Janārdana, at the end of Phālguna, on the full moon day, / is a festival celebrated in the world, in every village and in every town?

4.132.s:
kimarthaṃ śiśavastasyāṃ gehegehe'tivādinaḥ ..
holikā dīpyate kasmātphālgunāṃte kimucyate .. 2 ..
4.132.d:
किमर्थं शिशवस्तस्यां गेहेगेहेऽतिवादिनः ॥
होलिका दीप्यते कस्मात्फाल्गुनांते किमुच्यते ॥ 2 ॥
4.132.m: Why do children on that day make great noise in house after house? / Why is the Holikā kindled, and why is it spoken of at the end of Phālguna?

4.132.s:
aḍāḍeti ca kā saṃjñā śītoṣṇeti kimucyate ..
ko hyasyāṃ pūjyate devaḥ keneyamavatāritā ..
kimasyāṃ kriyate kṛṣṇa etadvistarato vada .. 3 .. ..
4.132.d:
अडाडेति च का संज्ञा शीतोष्णेति किमुच्यते ॥
को ह्यस्यां पूज्यते देवः केनेयमवतारिता ॥
किमस्यां क्रियते कृष्ण एतद्विस्तरतो वद ॥ 3 ॥ ॥
4.132.m: And what is the name "Aḍāḍā", and why is it called "Śītoṣṇā"? / What deity is worshipped on it, and by whom was this brought down? / What is done on this day, Kṛṣṇa? Tell this in full detail.

4.132.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
āsītkṛtayuge pārtha raghurnāma narādhipaḥ ..
śūraḥ sarvaguṇopataḥ priyavādī bahuśrutaḥ .. 4 ..
4.132.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
आसीत्कृतयुगे पार्थ रघुर्नाम नराधिपः ॥
शूरः सर्वगुणोपतः प्रियवादी बहुश्रुतः ॥ 4 ॥
4.132.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In the Kṛtayuga, O son of Pṛthā, there was a king named Raghu, / heroic, endowed with all virtues, pleasant-spoken, and well-learned.

4.132.s:
sa sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ jitvā vaśīkṛtya narādhipān ..
dharmataḥ pālayāmāsa prajāḥ putrānivaurasān .. 5 ..
4.132.d:
स सर्वां पृथिवीं जित्वा वशीकृत्य नराधिपान् ॥
धर्मतः पालयामास प्रजाः पुत्रानिवौरसान् ॥ 5 ॥
4.132.m: Having conquered the whole earth and brought kings under his control, / he protected his subjects in accordance with dharma, like his own born sons.

4.132.s:
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ tathā ..
nādharmarucayaḥ paurāstasmiñchāsati pārthiva .. 6 ..
4.132.d:
न दुर्भिक्षं न च व्याधिर्नाकालमरणं तथा ॥
नाधर्मरुचयः पौरास्तस्मिञ्छासति पार्थिव ॥ 6 ॥
4.132.m: There was no famine, no disease, and likewise no untimely death, / nor did the citizens delight in unrighteousness while he ruled, O king.

4.132.s:
tasyaivaṃ śāsato rājyaṃ kṣātradharmaratasya vai ..
paurāḥ sarve samāgamya pāhipāhītyathābruvan.. 7 ..
4.132.d:
तस्यैवं शासतो राज्यं क्षात्रधर्मरतस्य वै ॥
पौराः सर्वे समागम्य पाहिपाहीत्यथाब्रुवन्॥ 7 ॥
4.132.m: While he was thus ruling the kingdom, devoted to the duty of the warrior class, / all the citizens came together and said: "Protect us! Protect us!"

4.132.s:
.. paurā ūcuḥ ..
asmākaṃ hi gṛhe kāciḍhḍhauṃḍhā nāmeti rākṣasī ..
divā rātrau samāgamya bālānpīḍayate balāt ..8..
4.132.d:
॥ पौरा ऊचुः ॥
अस्माकं हि गृहे काचिढ्ढौंढा नामेति राक्षसी ॥
दिवा रात्रौ समागम्य बालान्पीडयते बलात् ॥8॥
4.132.m: The citizens said: / Indeed, in our homes, a certain rākṣasī named Ḍhoṇḍhā, / coming by day and by night, forcibly torments the children.

4.132.s:
rakṣayā kaṃḍakenāpi bheṣajairvā narādhipa ..
maṃtrajñaiḥ paramācāryaiḥ sā niyaṃtuṃ na śakyate .. 9 ..
4.132.d:
रक्षया कंडकेनापि भेषजैर्वा नराधिप ॥
मंत्रज्ञैः परमाचार्यैः सा नियंतुं न शक्यते ॥ 9 ॥
4.132.m: Neither by protective ash, nor by a thorn, nor by remedies, O king, / nor by supreme teachers skilled in mantras can she be restrained.

4.132.s:
paurāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā raghurvismayamāgataḥ ..
vismayāviṣṭahṛdayaḥ purohitamathābravīt..4.132.10.
4.132.d:
पौराणां वचनं श्रुत्वा रघुर्विस्मयमागतः ॥
विस्मयाविष्टहृदयः पुरोहितमथाब्रवीत्॥4.132.10.
4.132.m: Hearing the speech of the citizens, Raghu was filled with astonishment. / His heart overcome with wonder, he then spoke to his family priest.

4.132.s:
.. raghuruvāca .. ..
ḍhauṃḍheti rākṣasī keyaṃ kiṃprabhāvā dvijottama ..
kathameṣā niyaṃtavyā mayā duṣkṛtakāriṇī .. 11 ..
4.132.d:
॥ रघुरुवाच ॥ ॥
ढौंढेति राक्षसी केयं किंप्रभावा द्विजोत्तम ॥
कथमेषा नियंतव्या मया दुष्कृतकारिणी ॥ 11 ॥
4.132.m: Raghu said: / Who is this rākṣasī named Ḍhoṇḍhā? What is her power, O best of the twice-born? / How is this evil-doer to be subdued by me?

4.132.s:
rakṣaṇātprocyate rājā pṛthivīpālanātpatiḥ ..
arakṣamāṇaḥ pṛthivīṃ rājā bhavati kilbiṣī .. 12 ..
4.132.d:
रक्षणात्प्रोच्यते राजा पृथिवीपालनात्पतिः ॥
अरक्षमाणः पृथिवीं राजा भवति किल्बिषी ॥ 12 ॥
4.132.m: A king is spoken of from protection, and a lord from guarding the earth. / A king who does not protect the earth becomes sinful.

4.132.s:
vaśiṣṭha uvāca ..
śṛṇu rājanparaṃ guhyaṃ yannākhyātaṃ mayā kvacit ..
ḍhauṃḍhā nāmeti vikhyātā rākṣasī mālinaḥ sutā .. 13 ..
4.132.d:
वशिष्ठ उवाच ॥
शृणु राजन्परं गुह्यं यन्नाख्यातं मया क्वचित् ॥
ढौंढा नामेति विख्याता राक्षसी मालिनः सुता ॥ 13 ॥
4.132.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / Hear, O king, a supreme secret that has not been told by me anywhere. / Renowned by the name Ḍhoṇḍhā is a rākṣasī, the daughter of Mālin.

4.132.s:
tayā cārādhitaḥ śaṃbhurugreṇa tapasā purā ..
prītastāmāha bhagavānvaraṃ varaya suvrate .. 14 ..
4.132.d:
तया चाराधितः शंभुरुग्रेण तपसा पुरा ॥
प्रीतस्तामाह भगवान्वरं वरय सुव्रते ॥ 14 ॥
4.132.m: In ancient times, Śambhu was worshipped by her with fierce austerities. / Pleased, the Blessed Lord said to her: "Choose a boon, O lady of good vows!

4.132.s:
yatte manobhilaṣitaṃ taddadāmyavicāritam ..
ḍhauṃḍhā prāha mahādevaṃ yadi tuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ mama .. 15 ..
4.132.d:
यत्ते मनोभिलषितं तद्ददाम्यविचारितम् ॥
ढौंढा प्राह महादेवं यदि तुष्टः स्वयं मम ॥ 15 ॥
4.132.m: Whatever is desired by your mind, that I grant without hesitation." / Ḍhoṇḍhā said to Mahādeva: "If you yourself are pleased with me,

4.132.s:
na ca vadhyāṃ surādīnāṃ manujānāṃ ca śaṃkara ..
māṃ kuru tvaṃ trilokeśa śastrāstrāṇāṃ tathaiva ca .. 16 ..
4.132.d:
न च वध्यां सुरादीनां मनुजानां च शंकर ॥
मां कुरु त्वं त्रिलोकेश शस्त्रास्त्राणां तथैव च ॥ 16 ॥
4.132.m: make me not capable of being slain by gods and others, or by men, O Śaṅkara, / and likewise by weapons or missiles, O Lord of the three worlds!

4.132.s:
śītoṣṇavarṣāsamaye divā rātrau bahirgṛhe ..
abhayaṃ sarvadā me syāttvatprasādānmaheśvara .. 17 ..
4.132.d:
शीतोष्णवर्षासमये दिवा रात्रौ बहिर्गृहे ॥
अभयं सर्वदा मे स्यात्त्वत्प्रसादान्महेश्वर ॥ 17 ॥
4.132.m: In the cold, hot, and rainy seasons, by day, by night, outside, or in a house, / let there always be fearlessness for me by your grace, O Maheśvara!"

4.132.s:
śaṃkara uvāca ..
evamastvityathoktvā tāṃ punaḥ provāca śūlabhṛt ..
unmattebhyaḥ śiśubhyaśca bhayaṃ te saṃbhaviṣyati ..
ṛtāvṛtau mahābhāge mā vyathāṃ hṛdaye kṛthāḥ .. 18 ..
4.132.d:
शंकर उवाच ॥
एवमस्त्वित्यथोक्त्वा तां पुनः प्रोवाच शूलभृत् ॥
उन्मत्तेभ्यः शिशुभ्यश्च भयं ते संभविष्यति ॥
ऋतावृतौ महाभागे मा व्यथां हृदये कृथाः ॥ 18 ॥
4.132.m: Śaṅkara said: / Having said to her, "So be it," the bearer of the trident spoke again: / "Your fear shall arise from madmen and children / at every change of season, O highly fortunate lady; do not make anguish in your heart."

4.132.s:
evaṃ datvā varaṃ tasyai bhagavānbhaganetrahā ..
svapne labdho yathārthārthastatraivāṃtarhito'bhavat .. 19 ..
4.132.d:
एवं दत्वा वरं तस्यै भगवान्भगनेत्रहा ॥
स्वप्ने लब्धो यथार्थार्थस्तत्रैवांतर्हितोऽभवत् ॥ 19 ॥
4.132.m: Having thus granted a boon to her, the Blessed Lord, the destroyer of the eyes of Bhaga, / vanished right there, like wealth obtained in a dream.

4.132.s:
evaṃ labdhavarā sā tu rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī ..
nityaṃ pīḍayate bālānsaṃsmṛtya harabhāṣitam ..4.132.20..
4.132.d:
एवं लब्धवरा सा तु राक्षसी कामरूपिणी ॥
नित्यं पीडयते बालान्संस्मृत्य हरभाषितम् ॥4.132.20॥
4.132.m: Having thus obtained the boon, that rākṣasī, capable of assuming forms at will, / constantly torments the children, remembering what Hara had spoken.

4.132.s:
aḍāḍayeti gṛhṇāti siddhamaṃtraṃ kuṭuṃbinī ..
gṛheṣu tena sā loke hyaḍāḍetyabhidhīyate .. 21 ..
4.132.d:
अडाडयेति गृह्णाति सिद्धमंत्रं कुटुंबिनी ॥
गृहेषु तेन सा लोके ह्यडाडेत्यभिधीयते ॥ 21 ॥
4.132.m: A housewife invokes her with the perfected mantra "Aḍāḍā"; / therefore, she is known in the world as "Aḍāḍā" in the houses.

4.132.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ ḍhauṃḍhāyāścaritaṃ mayā ..
sāṃprataṃ kathayiṣyāmi yenopāyena hanyate ..22..
4.132.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं ढौंढायाश्चरितं मया ॥
सांप्रतं कथयिष्यामि येनोपायेन हन्यते ॥22॥
4.132.m: All this deed of Ḍhoṇḍhā has been told to you by me. / Now I shall tell the means by which she is slain.

4.132.s:
adya pañcadaśī śuklā phālgunasya narādhipa ..
śītakālo viniṣkrāṃtaḥ prātargrīṣmo bhaviṣyati .. 23 ..
4.132.d:
अद्य पञ्चदशी शुक्ला फाल्गुनस्य नराधिप ॥
शीतकालो विनिष्क्रांतः प्रातर्ग्रीष्मो भविष्यति ॥ 23 ॥
4.132.m: Today is the fifteenth day of the bright fortnight of Phālguna, O ruler of men. / The cold season has departed; tomorrow morning it will be summer.

4.132.s:
abhayapradānaṃ lokānāṃ dīyatāṃ puruṣottama ..
yathādyāśaṃkitā lokā ramaṃti ca hasaṃti ca .. 24 ..
4.132.d:
अभयप्रदानं लोकानां दीयतां पुरुषोत्तम ॥
यथाद्याशंकिता लोका रमंति च हसंति च ॥ 24 ॥
4.132.m: Let the gift of fearlessness be given to the people, O best of men, / so that today, freed from anxiety, the people may sport and laugh.

4.132.s:
dārujāni ca khaṃḍāni gṛhītvā samarotsukāḥ ..
yodhā iva viniryāṃtu śiśavaḥ saṃpraharṣitāḥ .. 25 ..
4.132.d:
दारुजानि च खंडानि गृहीत्वा समरोत्सुकाः ॥
योधा इव विनिर्यांतु शिशवः संप्रहर्षिताः ॥ 25 ॥
4.132.m: Taking wooden sticks, eager for battle, / let the children march out greatly delighted, like warriors.

4.132.s:
saṃcayaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhānāmupalānāṃ ca kārayet ..
tatrāgniṃ vidhivaddhutvā rakṣoghnairmantravistaraiḥ .. 26 ..
4.132.d:
संचयं शुष्ककाष्ठानामुपलानां च कारयेत् ॥
तत्राग्निं विधिवद्धुत्वा रक्षोघ्नैर्मन्त्रविस्तरैः ॥ 26 ॥
4.132.m: One should cause a heap of dry wood and cow-dung cakes to be made. / Having offered fire there in accordance with rule, with extensive demon-slaying mantras,

4.132.s:
tataḥ kilakilāśabdaistālaśabdairmanoharaiḥ ..
tamagniṃ triḥ parikramya gāyaṃtu ca hasaṃtu ca ..
jalpaṃtu svecchayā lokā niḥśaṃkā yasya yanmatam .. 27 ..
4.132.d:
ततः किलकिलाशब्दैस्तालशब्दैर्मनोहरैः ॥
तमग्निं त्रिः परिक्रम्य गायंतु च हसंतु च ॥
जल्पंतु स्वेच्छया लोका निःशंका यस्य यन्मतम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.132.m: then, with joyous shouts and charming hand-clappings, / let them circumambulate that fire three times, and let them sing and laugh, / and let people chatter freely, without fear, whatever is on anyone's mind.

4.132.s:
tena śabdena sā pāpā homena ca nirā kṛtā ..
adṛṣṭaghātairḍiṃbhānāṃ rākṣasī kṣayameṣyati ..28..
4.132.d:
तेन शब्देन सा पापा होमेन च निरा कृता ॥
अदृष्टघातैर्डिंभानां राक्षसी क्षयमेष्यति ॥28॥
4.132.m: Repelled by that sound and by the oblation, / that wicked rākṣasī will perish from unseen blows upon children.

4.132.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
tasyarṣervacanaṃ śrutvā sa nṛpaḥ pāṃḍunadana..
sarvaṃ cakāra vidhivaduktaṃ tena ca dhīmatā ..29..
4.132.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
तस्यर्षेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा स नृपः पांडुनदन॥
सर्वं चकार विधिवदुक्तं तेन च धीमता ॥29॥
4.132.m: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Having heard the words of that ṛṣi, O son of Pāṇḍu, that king / performed everything properly as spoken by that wise one.

4.132.s:
gatā sā rākṣasī nāśaṃ tena cogreṇa karmaṇā ..
tataḥ prabhṛti loke'sminnaḍāḍā khyātimāgatā..4.132.30.
4.132.d:
गता सा राक्षसी नाशं तेन चोग्रेण कर्मणा ॥
ततः प्रभृति लोकेऽस्मिन्नडाडा ख्यातिमागता॥4.132.30.
4.132.m: That rākṣasī went to destruction by that fierce act; / from that time on in this world, she came to be known as Aḍāḍā.

4.132.s:
sarvaduṣṭāpaho homaḥ sarvarogopaśāṃtidaḥ ..
kriyate'syāṃ dvijaiḥ pārtha tena sā holikā matā .. 31 ..
4.132.d:
सर्वदुष्टापहो होमः सर्वरोगोपशांतिदः ॥
क्रियतेऽस्यां द्विजैः पार्थ तेन सा होलिका मता ॥ 31 ॥
4.132.m: An oblation destroying all wicked beings and pacifying all diseases / is performed on this [day] by the twice-born, O Pārtha; therefore it is considered Holikā.

4.132.s:
sarvasārātiviśveyaṃ pūrvamāsīdyudhiṣṭhira ..
sāratvātphalgurityeṣā paramānaṃdadāyinī .. 32..
4.132.d:
सर्वसारातिविश्वेयं पूर्वमासीद्युधिष्ठिर ॥
सारत्वात्फल्गुरित्येषा परमानंददायिनी ॥ 32॥
4.132.m: Formerly, O Yudhiṣṭhira, this [tithi] was the essence of everything and entirely universal; / because of its excellence, it is called Phalgu, granting supreme bliss.

4.132.s:
asyāṃ niśāgame pārtha saṃrakṣyāḥ śiśavo gṛhe ..
gomayenopasaṃlipte sacatuṣke gṛhāṃgaṇe .. 33 ..
4.132.d:
अस्यां निशागमे पार्थ संरक्ष्याः शिशवो गृहे ॥
गोमयेनोपसंलिप्ते सचतुष्के गृहांगणे ॥ 33 ॥
4.132.m: At the coming of night on this [day], O Pārtha, children are to be protected in the house, / in the courtyard of the house smeared with cow dung and marked with a square.

4.132.s:
ākārayecchiśuprāyānkhaḍgavyagra karānnarān ..
te kāṣṭhakhaṇḍaiḥ saṃspṛśya gītairhāsyakaraiḥ śiśūn ..
rakṣaṃti teṣāṃ dātavyaṃ guḍaṃ pakvānnameva ca ..34..
4.132.d:
आकारयेच्छिशुप्रायान्खड्गव्यग्र करान्नरान् ॥
ते काष्ठखण्डैः संस्पृश्य गीतैर्हास्यकरैः शिशून् ॥
रक्षंति तेषां दातव्यं गुडं पक्वान्नमेव च ॥34॥
4.132.m: One should summon men, mostly youngsters, with swords ready in hand; / touching the children with pieces of wood, they protect [them] with merry songs; / to them should be given jaggery and cooked food.

4.132.s:
evaṃ ḍhauṃḍhitamātrasya sa doṣaḥ praśamaṃ vrajet ..
bālānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tasyāttasminniśāgame .. 35 ..
4.132.d:
एवं ढौंढितमात्रस्य स दोषः प्रशमं व्रजेत् ॥
बालानां रक्षणं कार्यं तस्यात्तस्मिन्निशागमे ॥ 35 ॥
4.132.m: In this way, as soon as it is searched, that misfortune goes to pacification; / therefore the protection of boys should be performed at the coming of night on that [day].

4.132.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
prabhāte kiñjanairdeva kartavyaṃ sukhamīpsubhiḥ ..
pravṛtte mādhave māsi pratipadbhāskarodaye .. 36 ..
4.132.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रभाते किञ्जनैर्देव कर्तव्यं सुखमीप्सुभिः ॥
प्रवृत्ते माधवे मासि प्रतिपद्भास्करोदये ॥ 36 ॥
4.132.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / At dawn, O Lord, when the month of Mādhava has begun / and the sun rises on the first lunar day, what should people desiring happiness do?

4.132.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kṛtvā cāvaśyakāryāṇi saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ ..
vaṃdayeddholikābhūtiṃ sarvaduṣṭopaśāṃtaye .. 37 ..
4.132.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
कृत्वा चावश्यकार्याणि संतर्प्य पितृदेवताः ॥
वंदयेद्धोलिकाभूतिं सर्वदुष्टोपशांतये ॥ 37 ॥
4.132.m: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Having performed obligatory duties and gratified the ancestors and deities, / one should revere the ashes of Holikā for the pacification of all wicked beings.

4.132.s:
maṃḍite carcite caiva upalipte gṛhājire ..
catuṣkaṃ kārayecchreṣṭhaṃ varṇakaiścākṣataiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 38 ..
4.132.d:
मंडिते चर्चिते चैव उपलिप्ते गृहाजिरे ॥
चतुष्कं कारयेच्छ्रेष्ठं वर्णकैश्चाक्षतैः शुभैः ॥ 38 ॥
4.132.m: In the courtyard of the house adorned, smeared, and smeared over [with cow dung], / one should make an excellent square with colored powders and auspicious unbroken grains of rice.

4.132.s:
tanmadhye sthāpayetpīṭhaṃ śuklavastrottara cchadam ..
agrataḥ pūrṇakalaśaṃ sthāpayetpallavairyutam.. 39 ..
4.132.d:
तन्मध्ये स्थापयेत्पीठं शुक्लवस्त्रोत्तर च्छदम् ॥
अग्रतः पूर्णकलशं स्थापयेत्पल्लवैर्युतम्॥ 39 ॥
4.132.m: In its center one should place a seat covered with a white cloth; / in front of it one should place a full water pot endowed with sprouts,

4.132.s:
sākṣataṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca sitacandanacarcitam..
kalaśasyāgrato deyā upānahavarāṃśukāḥ..4.132.40..
4.132.d:
साक्षतं सहिरण्यं च सितचन्दनचर्चितम्॥
कलशस्याग्रतो देया उपानहवरांशुकाः॥4.132.40॥
4.132.m: together with unbroken grains of rice and gold, smeared with white sandalwood; / in front of the water pot, shoes and fine garments should be presented.

4.132.s:
āsane copaviṣṭasya brahmaghoṣeṇa bhārata ..
carcayeccandanaṃ nārī avyaṃgāṃgā sulakṣaṇā .. 41 ..
4.132.d:
आसने चोपविष्टस्य ब्रह्मघोषेण भारत ॥
चर्चयेच्चन्दनं नारी अव्यंगांगा सुलक्षणा ॥ 41 ॥
4.132.m: To him who is seated upon the seat, amid the chanting of the Veda, O Bhārata, / an unblemished, auspicious woman should apply sandalwood [paste]—

4.132.s:
padmarāgottarapaṭā śreṣṭhāṃśukavibhūṣitā ..
vasudhārāṃ śirogre ca dadhidūrvākṣatānvitām.. 42 ..
4.132.d:
पद्मरागोत्तरपटा श्रेष्ठांशुकविभूषिता ॥
वसुधारां शिरोग्रे च दधिदूर्वाक्षतान्विताम्॥ 42 ॥
4.132.m: she who has an upper cloth [red like] ruby and is adorned with excellent garments— / and on the top of his head a stream of wealth accompanied by curds, dūrvā grass, and unbroken grains of rice.

4.132.s:
carcāpayitvā śrīkhaṃḍamāyurārogyavṛddhaye ..
paścācca prāśayedvidvāṃścūtapuṣpaṃ sacaṃdanam.. 43 ..
4.132.d:
चर्चापयित्वा श्रीखंडमायुरारोग्यवृद्धये ॥
पश्चाच्च प्राशयेद्विद्वांश्चूतपुष्पं सचंदनम्॥ 43 ॥
4.132.m: Having caused sandalwood paste to be smeared for the increase of longevity and health, / the wise man should afterwards consume mango blossom mixed with sandalwood.

4.132.s:
manobhavasya sā pūjā ṛṣibhiḥ saṃpradarśitā ..
ye pibaṃti vasaṃtādau cūtapuṣpaṃ sacandanam .. 44 ..
4.132.d:
मनोभवस्य सा पूजा ऋषिभिः संप्रदर्शिता ॥
ये पिबंति वसंतादौ चूतपुष्पं सचन्दनम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.132.m: That worship of the Mind-born One has been taught by the ṛṣis / for those who consume mango blossom mixed with sandalwood at the beginning of spring.

4.132.s:
satyaṃ hṛdisthakāmasya tatpūrtirjāyateñjasā ..
anaṃtaraṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ sūtamāgadhabaṃdinām .. 45 ..
4.132.d:
सत्यं हृदिस्थकामस्य तत्पूर्तिर्जायतेञ्जसा ॥
अनंतरं द्विजेन्द्राणां सूतमागधबंदिनाम् ॥ 45 ॥
4.132.m: Truly, the fulfillment of whatever desire resides in their heart quickly comes to pass. / Thereupon, to foremost Brahmins, sūtas, māgadhas, and bards,

4.132.s:
dadyāddānaṃ yathāśaktyā kāmo me prīyatāmiti ..
tato bhojanavelāyāṃ śṛtaṃ yatprāktane'hani .. 46 ..
4.132.d:
दद्याद्दानं यथाशक्त्या कामो मे प्रीयतामिति ॥
ततो भोजनवेलायां शृतं यत्प्राक्तनेऽहनि ॥ 46 ॥
4.132.m: he should make gifts according to his ability, saying: 'May the God of Love be pleased.' / Then at mealtime, having first eaten the food that was cooked

4.132.s:
prāśnīyātprathamaṃ cānnaṃ tato bhuñjīta kāmataḥ ..
ya evaṃ kurute pārtha śāstroktaṃ phālgunotsavam .. 47 ..
4.132.d:
प्राश्नीयात्प्रथमं चान्नं ततो भुञ्जीत कामतः ॥
य एवं कुरुते पार्थ शास्त्रोक्तं फाल्गुनोत्सवम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.132.m: on the previous day, he may eat at will. / The man who performs the Phālguna festival as taught in the scriptures in this way, O Pārtha,

4.132.s:
anāyāsena sidhyaṃti tasya sarve manorathāḥ ..
ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva yāṃti nāśaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..48..
4.132.d:
अनायासेन सिध्यंति तस्य सर्वे मनोरथाः ॥
आधयो व्याधयश्चैव यांति नाशं न संशयः ॥48॥
4.132.m: all his desires are accomplished without exertion; / mental agonies and physical diseases go to destruction, there is no doubt;

4.132.s: putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ .. 49 ..
4.132.d: पुत्रपौत्रसमायुक्तः सुखं तिष्ठति मानवः ॥ 49 ॥
4.132.m: and endowed with sons and grandsons, the man dwells happily.

4.132.s:
puṇyā pavitrā jayadā sarvavighravināśinī ..
eṣā te kathitā pārtha tithīnāmuttamā tithiḥ .. 4.132.50 ..
4.132.d:
पुण्या पवित्रा जयदा सर्वविघ्रविनाशिनी ॥
एषा ते कथिता पार्थ तिथीनामुत्तमा तिथिः ॥ 4.132.50 ॥
4.132.m: Meritorious, purifying, granting victory, destroying all obstacles: / this best lunar day among lunar days has been told to you, O Pārtha.

4.132.s:
vṛtte tuṣārasamaye sitapañcadaśyāṃ prātarvasantasamaye samupasthite ca ..
saṃprāśya cūtakusumaṃ saha candanena satyaṃ hi pārtha puruṣaḥ sa sukhī samāste .. 51 .. ..
āndolakavidhivarṇanam
4.132.d:
वृत्ते तुषारसमये सितपञ्चदश्यां प्रातर्वसन्तसमये समुपस्थिते च ॥
संप्राश्य चूतकुसुमं सह चन्दनेन सत्यं हि पार्थ पुरुषः स सुखी समास्ते ॥ 51 ॥ ॥
आन्दोलकविधिवर्णनम्
4.132.m:
When the cold season has passed, on the bright fifteenth [day], in the morning when the spring season has arrived, / having consumed mango blossom together with sandalwood, truly indeed, O Pārtha, that person dwells happily.
Description of the Swing Rite

4.133.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
saṃtyajyālikulālīḍhakusumāni mṛdūnyapi ..
damanena kathaṃ lokaiḥ pūjyaṃte nākanāyakāḥ .. 1 ..
4.133.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
संत्यज्यालिकुलालीढकुसुमानि मृदून्यपि ॥
दमनेन कथं लोकैः पूज्यंते नाकनायकाः ॥ 1 ॥
4.133.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Leaving aside soft flowers touched by swarms of bees, / why are the rulers of heaven worshipped by people with damanaka?

4.133.s:
dolāṃdolanamāhātmyaṃ rathayātrāmahotsavam ..
kathayasvāmalaṃ prājña yādavāṃbhojabhāskara .. 2 ... ..
4.133.d:
दोलांदोलनमाहात्म्यं रथयात्रामहोत्सवम् ॥
कथयस्वामलं प्राज्ञ यादवांभोजभास्कर ॥ 2 ॥॥।
4.133.m: The greatness of the swinging on a swing and the great festival of the chariot procession— / tell [me] this flawlessly, O wise one, O sun to the lotus that is the Yādava race!

4.133.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
pārthārthijanasadvṛkṣa kṣāṃtidhāma dharāpate ..
yadetadbhavatā pṛṣṭaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva vadāmi te .. 34
4.133.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पार्थार्थिजनसद्वृक्ष क्षांतिधाम धरापते ॥
यदेतद्भवता पृष्टं तच्छृणुष्व वदामि ते ॥ 34
4.133.m: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / O Pārtha, O wishing tree to supplicants, O abode of patience, O lord of the earth! / That which was asked by you, listen to it; I will tell you.

4.133.s:
purā surāṇāmāvāse maṃdare cārukaṃdare ..
gandhādhārī kulālīḍho jāto damanakastaruḥ .. 4 ..
4.133.d:
पुरा सुराणामावासे मंदरे चारुकंदरे ॥
गन्धाधारी कुलालीढो जातो दमनकस्तरुः ॥ 4 ॥
4.133.m: Formerly, in the abode of the gods on Mount Mandara with its lovely caves, / the damanaka plant was born, bearing fragrance and touched by bees.

4.133.s:
tasya gaṃdhamanāghreyamāghrāya surayoṣitaḥ ..
madanonmādavaśagā gāyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca ..5..
4.133.d:
तस्य गंधमनाघ्रेयमाघ्राय सुरयोषितः ॥
मदनोन्मादवशगा गायंति च हसंति च ॥5॥
4.133.m: Smelling its fragrance which should not have been smelled, the celestial women, / falling under the power of the intoxication of passion, sang and laughed.

4.133.s:
ṛṣayo niyamāṃstyaktvā prādravaṃta gṛhānprati ..
na vedādhyayane dhyāne ratisteṣāṃ babhūva ha .6..
4.133.d:
ऋषयो नियमांस्त्यक्त्वा प्राद्रवंत गृहान्प्रति ॥
न वेदाध्ययने ध्याने रतिस्तेषां बभूव ह .6॥
4.133.m: The ṛṣis, abandoning their vows, ran toward their houses; / there was no delight for them in Vedic study or meditation.

4.133.s:
aparādhādvighaṭitaṃ yadbabhūva priye param..
mānasaṃ māninīnāṃ tu punargaṃdhena saṃdhitam .. 7 ..
4.133.d:
अपराधाद्विघटितं यद्बभूव प्रिये परम्॥
मानसं मानिनीनां तु पुनर्गंधेन संधितम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.133.m: The heart of proud women, which had been deeply alienated / from their lover due to an offense, was reunited again by that fragrance.

4.133.s:
gaṃdhenākulitaṃ lokaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā tamabravīt ..
śamanirmitayā vācā roṣātprasphuritādharaḥ .. 8 .. ..
4.133.d:
गंधेनाकुलितं लोकं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा तमब्रवीत् ॥
शमनिर्मितया वाचा रोषात्प्रस्फुरिताधरः ॥ 8 ॥ ॥
4.133.m: Seeing the world agitated by the fragrance, Brahmā spoke to it / in words forged with restraint, his lower lip trembling with wrath.

4.133.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
jātastvaṃ lokadamanānnūnaṃ damanako mayā ..
jagadvā ghūrṇase kasmātkarma naitattavocitam .. 9 ..
4.133.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥ ॥
जातस्त्वं लोकदमनान्नूनं दमनको मया ॥
जगद्वा घूर्णसे कस्मात्कर्म नैतत्तवोचितम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.133.m: Brahmā said: / You were born surely from subduing the world, hence [named] Damanaka by me; / why do you agitate the universe? This action is not fitting for you.

4.133.s:
yatsaṃtastvanumanyaṃte sarvā tiśayavarjitam ..
tatseveta naraḥ karma yatrodvego na dhīmatām .. 4.133.10 ..
4.133.d:
यत्संतस्त्वनुमन्यंते सर्वा तिशयवर्जितम् ॥
तत्सेवेत नरः कर्म यत्रोद्वेगो न धीमताम् ॥ 4.133.10 ॥
4.133.m: That which the virtuous approve, free from every excess, / a man should pursue that action in which there is no distress for the wise.

4.133.s:
ekasyāpyapakāraṃ yaḥ karoti sa narādhamaḥ ..
bahūnāmapakārāya sapravṛtaḥ kimucyate .. 11 ..
4.133.d:
एकस्याप्यपकारं यः करोति स नराधमः ॥
बहूनामपकाराय सप्रवृतः किमुच्यते ॥ 11 ॥
4.133.m: He who causes harm even to one person is the lowest of men; / what can be said of him who is bent upon harm to many?

4.133.s:
dṛṣṭārthabādhakaṃ karma na kartavyaṃ kathaṃcana ..
adṛṣṭaṃ prati saṃdehaḥ sosmābhiranumīyate .. 12 ..
4.133.d:
दृष्टार्थबाधकं कर्म न कर्तव्यं कथंचन ॥
अदृष्टं प्रति संदेहः सोस्माभिरनुमीयते ॥ 12 ॥
4.133.m: An action which obstructs visible purposes should never be done; / as for the unseen result, there is doubt; it is merely inferred by us.

4.133.s:
tataḥ svayaṃ prabhajati daive pitrye ca karmaṇi ..
bhogārthe ca tribhuvananirādeyo bhaviṣyati .. 13 ..
4.133.d:
ततः स्वयं प्रभजति दैवे पित्र्ये च कर्मणि ॥
भोगार्थे च त्रिभुवननिरादेयो भविष्यति ॥ 13 ॥
4.133.m: Therefore, when one engages oneself in rites for the gods and ancestors / and for enjoyment, you shall be unacceptable to the three worlds.

4.133.s:
.. damanaka uvāca .. ..
puruṣādevamārabdhaṃ na krodhānnārthakāra ṇāt ..
svabhāva eṣa me brahmaṃstvayā sṛṣṭaḥ purā vibho .. 14 ..
4.133.d:
॥ दमनक उवाच ॥ ॥
पुरुषादेवमारब्धं न क्रोधान्नार्थकार णात् ॥
स्वभाव एष मे ब्रह्मंस्त्वया सृष्टः पुरा विभो ॥ 14 ॥
4.133.m: Damanaka said: / This was begun solely from destiny, not from anger, nor for the sake of wealth; / this nature of mine, O Brahmā, was created formerly by you, O omnipresent Lord!

4.133.s:
yā yasya jaṃtoḥ prakṛtiḥ śubhā vā yadi vetarā ..
sa tasyāmeva ramate duṣkṛte sukṛte tathā .. 15 ..
4.133.d:
या यस्य जंतोः प्रकृतिः शुभा वा यदि वेतरा ॥
स तस्यामेव रमते दुष्कृते सुकृते तथा ॥ 15 ॥
4.133.m: Whatever nature belongs to a creature, whether auspicious or otherwise, / in that alone does he find delight, whether in evil deeds or in good deeds.

4.133.s:
tatsvabhāvapravṛttasya yadi śāpastvayā mama ..
pradattaḥ kiṃ karomyetanna kṛtyamaparādhyati .'. 16 ..
4.133.d:
तत्स्वभावप्रवृत्तस्य यदि शापस्त्वया मम ॥
प्रदत्तः किं करोम्येतन्न कृत्यमपराध्यति ।'. 16 ॥
4.133.m: Therefore, if a curse has been given by you to me who acted according to my nature, / what can I do about this? Action does not offend [against destiny].

4.133.s:
yuktiyuktaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā damanena samī ritam ..
prītātmā padmajaḥ prāha karomi tava satpriyam .. 17 ..
4.133.d:
युक्तियुक्तं वचः श्रुत्वा दमनेन समी रितम् ॥
प्रीतात्मा पद्मजः प्राह करोमि तव सत्प्रियम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.133.m: Hearing the reasoned statement uttered by Damana, / the Lotus-born One, pleased in his mind, said: 'I shall do what is truly pleasing to you.'

4.133.s:
vasaṃte sahakārotthamaṃjarīpiṃjare jane ..
puṣpitāśokaśobhāḍhye vane puṃskokilā kule .. 18 ..
4.133.d:
वसंते सहकारोत्थमंजरीपिंजरे जने ॥
पुष्पिताशोकशोभाढ्ये वने पुंस्कोकिला कुले ॥ 18 ॥
4.133.m: In spring, when the people are tawny with mango blossoms, / in the forest crowded with male cuckoos and rich in the beauty of flowering aśoka trees,

4.133.s:
tasminkāle sureśānāṃ śirāṃsyākramya līlayā ..
sthāsyasi tvaṃ dinaṃ caikaṃ yadyasya vihitaṃ hitam .. 19 ..
4.133.d:
तस्मिन्काले सुरेशानां शिरांस्याक्रम्य लीलया ॥
स्थास्यसि त्वं दिनं चैकं यद्यस्य विहितं हितम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.133.m: at that time, resting playfully upon the heads of the lords of the gods, / you will abide for one day, since this beneficial deed has been ordained for you.

4.133.s:
ye tvāmāropayiṣyaṃti dānamānapurassarāḥ ..
surāṇāṃ te bhaviṣyaṃti sadaiva sukhino narāḥ .. 4.133.20 ..
4.133.d:
ये त्वामारोपयिष्यंति दानमानपुरस्सराः ॥
सुराणां ते भविष्यंति सदैव सुखिनो नराः ॥ 4.133.20 ॥
4.133.m: Those men who will place you [there] after gifts and honors, / will always remain happy before the gods.

4.133.s:
sarvadaiva śivasyeṣṭā puṇyā pāpabhayāpahā ..
prasiddhiṃ yāsyati madhau damanākhyā caturdaśī .. 21 ..
4.133.d:
सर्वदैव शिवस्येष्टा पुण्या पापभयापहा ॥
प्रसिद्धिं यास्यति मधौ दमनाख्या चतुर्दशी ॥ 21 ॥
4.133.m: Always beloved of Śiva, sacred, removing the fear of sin, / the fourteenth [lunar day] named Damanā in the month of Madhu will attain renown.

4.133.s:
evamuktvā yayau brahmā damano maṃdare girau ..
uvāsa vāsitāśeṣabhuvano gaṃdhasampadā .. 22 ..
4.133.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ययौ ब्रह्मा दमनो मंदरे गिरौ ॥
उवास वासिताशेषभुवनो गंधसम्पदा ॥ 22 ॥
4.133.m: Having spoken thus, Brahmā departed; and Damanaka dwelled on Mount Mandara, / perfuming all the worlds with his abundance of fragrance.

4.133.s:
divye girau girisu tādayitādhivāse ratnāṃśukacchuritakāñcanabhūmibhāge ..
śāpaṃ varaṃ ca hṛdaye viniveśya śaṃbhostatrāsthito damanako damitāṃtarātmā .. 23 ..
4.133.d:
दिव्ये गिरौ गिरिसु तादयिताधिवासे रत्नांशुकच्छुरितकाञ्चनभूमिभागे ॥
शापं वरं च हृदये विनिवेश्य शंभोस्तत्रास्थितो दमनको दमितांतरात्मा ॥ 23 ॥
4.133.m: Upon that divine mountain, the beloved abode of the Mountain's daughter, where the golden ground was inlayed with radiant gems, / having placed both Śambhu's curse and boon in his heart, Damanaka remained there, master of his inner self.

4.133.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
dharmarāja nibodhedamāṃdolakamahotsavam ..
pravṛttanaranārīkaṃ pañcamoccārasundaram..24..
4.133.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
धर्मराज निबोधेदमांदोलकमहोत्सवम् ॥
प्रवृत्तनरनारीकं पञ्चमोच्चारसुन्दरम्॥24॥
4.133.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / O King of Dharma, learn now of this great festival of the swing, / in which men and women engage, delightful with the sounding of the fifth note.

4.133.s:
sānaṃdaṃ naṃdanavane ārdrayā sahito yathā ..
vismayasmeranayano babhrāmodvāṃtasaurabhaḥ .. 25 ..
4.133.d:
सानंदं नंदनवने आर्द्रया सहितो यथा ॥
विस्मयस्मेरनयनो बभ्रामोद्वांतसौरभः ॥ 25 ॥
4.133.m: Joyfully in the Nandana grove, together with Ārdrā, / with eyes smiling in wonder, exuding fragrance, he wandered,

4.133.s:
unmādayanvane puṇye vidyādharagaṇānbahūn ..
vasaṃtartau nṛtyamānānmurāsuraśatārcitaḥ .. .. 26 ..
4.133.d:
उन्मादयन्वने पुण्ये विद्याधरगणान्बहून् ॥
वसंतर्तौ नृत्यमानान्मुरासुरशतार्चितः ॥ ॥ 26 ॥
4.133.m: intoxicating the many hosts of Vidyādharas in the sacred forest, / dancing in the spring season, worshipped by hundreds of foes of the demon Mura.

4.133.s:
saṃtānapārijātotthāṃ baddhvā sa mādhavīlatām ..
kaścidāṃdolanaṃ cakre samāliṃgya ghanastanīm .. 27 ..
4.133.d:
संतानपारिजातोत्थां बद्ध्वा स माधवीलताम् ॥
कश्चिदांदोलनं चक्रे समालिंग्य घनस्तनीम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.133.m: Having fastened a mādhavī creeper born of the saṃtāna and pārijāta trees, / someone swung, embracing a woman with full breasts.

4.133.s:
gītamāṃdolakārūḍhastadgāyaṃtyamara striyaḥ ..
yena cotpādayaṃti sma manmathasyāpi manmatham .. 28 ..
4.133.d:
गीतमांदोलकारूढस्तद्गायंत्यमर स्त्रियः ॥
येन चोत्पादयंति स्म मन्मथस्यापि मन्मथम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.133.m: Mounted on the swing, they sang; the wives of the immortals sang that song / by which they produced love even in the God of Love.

4.133.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvāṣṭāpadanibhā bhavānī prāha śaṃkaram ..
kautukaṃ me samutpannaṃ paśyemāḥ śaṃkara prabho .. 29 ..
4.133.d:
तं दृष्ट्वाष्टापदनिभा भवानी प्राह शंकरम् ॥
कौतुकं मे समुत्पन्नं पश्येमाः शंकर प्रभो ॥ 29 ॥
4.133.m: Seeing him, Bhavānī, who shone like gold, spoke to Śaṅkara: / "Curiosity has arisen in me; behold them, O Lord Śaṅkara!

4.133.s:
ādolakaṃ mama kṛte kārayasva svalaṃkṛtam ..
tvayā sahāṃdolayeyaṃ yathā caite trilocana..4.133.30..
4.133.d:
आदोलकं मम कृते कारयस्व स्वलंकृतम् ॥
त्वया सहांदोलयेयं यथा चैते त्रिलोचन॥4.133.30॥
4.133.m: Have a well-adorned swing made for my sake, / so that I may swing together with you, O three-eyed lord, just like these!"

4.133.s:
tadgaurīvacanaṃ ramyaṃ śrutvā govṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
saddolāṃ kārayāmāsa samāhūya mahāsurān ..31..
4.133.d:
तद्गौरीवचनं रम्यं श्रुत्वा गोवृषभध्वजः ॥
सद्दोलां कारयामास समाहूय महासुरान् ॥31॥
4.133.m: Hearing those charming words of Gaurī, he whose banner is the bull / summoned the great asuras and had an excellent swing fashioned.

4.133.s:
staṃbhadvayaṃ ropayitvā iṣṭāpūrtamayaṃ dṛḍham ..
satyaṃ caivoparitataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhamakalpayat .. ..32..
4.133.d:
स्तंभद्वयं रोपयित्वा इष्टापूर्तमयं दृढम् ॥
सत्यं चैवोपरिततं श्रेष्ठं काष्ठमकल्पयत् ॥ ॥32॥
4.133.m: Having erected two firm pillars consisting of sacrificial and pious works, / he fashioned the truth above it into a spread, excellent crossbeam.

4.133.s:
vāsukiṃ daṃḍakasthāne baddhvā tāṃtavasaprabham ..
tatphaṇāmaṃtarāpīṭhaṃ kṛtavānmaṇimaṃḍitam .. 33 ..
4.133.d:
वासुकिं दंडकस्थाने बद्ध्वा तांतवसप्रभम् ॥
तत्फणामंतरापीठं कृतवान्मणिमंडितम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.133.m: Having bound Vāsuki, lustrous as thread, in place of the pole, / he made a seat within his hoods adorned with jewels.

4.133.s:
kṛmikārpāsakauśeyavastraiḥ saṃveṣṭitaṃ navaiḥ ..
sragdāmālaṃbitaprāṃtamaṇimauktikaśekharam..34..
4.133.d:
कृमिकार्पासकौशेयवस्त्रैः संवेष्टितं नवैः ॥
स्रग्दामालंबितप्रांतमणिमौक्तिकशेखरम्॥34॥
4.133.m: It was wrapped in new fabrics made of wild silk, cotton, and woven silk, / with its borders hung with wreaths of garlands, crowned with jewels and pearls.

4.133.s:
racayitvā vicitrāṃ tāṃ dolāṃ cailājinottarām ..
sa siddhāṃ siddhagurave gauraveṇa nyavedayat ..35..
4.133.d:
रचयित्वा विचित्रां तां दोलां चैलाजिनोत्तराम् ॥
स सिद्धां सिद्धगुरवे गौरवेण न्यवेदयत् ॥35॥
4.133.m: Having fashioned that wondrous swing covered with clothes and deer-skins, / he, having completed it, respectfully offered it to the guru of the Siddhas.

4.133.s:
tatrārūḍhastu yāvatsa saumyasomavibhūṣaṇaḥ ..
maṃdaraṃ dolayāmāsa pārśvasthaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ saha ..36..
4.133.d:
तत्रारूढस्तु यावत्स सौम्यसोमविभूषणः ॥
मंदरं दोलयामास पार्श्वस्थैः पार्षदैः सह ॥36॥
4.133.m: As soon as he, adorned with the gentle moon, mounted it, / he swung Mandara along with his attendants standing at his side.

4.133.s:
vāmapārśve tu vijayā dakṣiṇena jayā bhavet ..
cāmarākrāṃtabāhū te tenāśliṣṭe nyavījatām .. 37 ..
4.133.d:
वामपार्श्वे तु विजया दक्षिणेन जया भवेत् ॥
चामराक्रांतबाहू ते तेनाश्लिष्टे न्यवीजताम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.133.m: On the left side stood Vijayā, and on the right Jayā; / their arms occupied with chowries, embraced by him, they fanned him.

4.133.s:
ādolayaṃtyā pārvatyā sahitaṃ sa gadākṣaram ..
yena devāsurastraiṇamāsīdānaṃdanirbharam .. 38 ..
4.133.d:
आदोलयंत्या पार्वत्या सहितं स गदाक्षरम् ॥
येन देवासुरस्त्रैणमासीदानंदनिर्भरम् ॥ 38 ॥
4.133.m: Together with Pārvatī who was swinging [him], he spoke in a choked voice, / whereby the women of the gods and asuras became filled with joy.

4.133.s:
jagurgaṃdharvapatayo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ..
ucchalattālavādyāni vādayaṃti sma cāraṇāḥ .. 39 ..
4.133.d:
जगुर्गंधर्वपतयो ननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः ॥
उच्छलत्तालवाद्यानि वादयंति स्म चारणाः ॥ 39 ॥
4.133.m: The masters of the Gandharvas sang, and troops of apsarases danced; / the Cāraṇas played musical instruments that burst forth with rhythm.

4.133.s:
celuḥ kulācalāḥ sarve cukṣubhuḥ sapta sāgarāḥ ..
vavurvātāḥ sanirghātā deve dolāṃ samāsthite .. 4.133.40 ..
4.133.d:
चेलुः कुलाचलाः सर्वे चुक्षुभुः सप्त सागराः ॥
ववुर्वाताः सनिर्घाता देवे दोलां समास्थिते ॥ 4.133.40 ॥
4.133.m: All the principal mountain ranges shook, the seven oceans surged, / and winds blew with thunderbolts when the god mounted the swing.

4.133.s:
ālokya vyākulaṃ lokaṃ devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ ..
upetya praṇipatyocuḥ sarvapāpaharaṃ param .. 41 ..
4.133.d:
आलोक्य व्याकुलं लोकं देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः ॥
उपेत्य प्रणिपत्योचुः सर्वपापहरं परम् ॥ 41 ॥
4.133.m: Beholding the world perturbed, the gods, led by Śakra, / approached and, bowing down, spoke to the supreme remover of all sins:

4.133.s:
upāramasva bhagavanbhavataḥ krīḍayānayā ..
jagadvyāpadyate deve calitaḥ sāgaraśca yat .. 42 ..
4.133.d:
उपारमस्व भगवन्भवतः क्रीडयानया ॥
जगद्व्यापद्यते देवे चलितः सागरश्च यत् ॥ 42 ॥
4.133.m: "Desist, O Lord! By this play of yours / the universe is perishing, O God, and the ocean is agitated!"

4.133.s:
gīrvāṇagīrbhiḥ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ..
samutpapāta dolātaḥ praharṣotphullalocanaḥ .. 43 ..
4.133.d:
गीर्वाणगीर्भिः संहृष्टः शंकरो लोकशंकरः ॥
समुत्पपात दोलातः प्रहर्षोत्फुल्ललोचनः ॥ 43 ॥
4.133.m: Gladdened by the words of the gods, Śaṅkara, the bringer of welfare to the world, / sprang down from the swing, his eyes wide open with delight.

4.133.s:
uvāca vacanaṃ pārtha surasārthasya paśyataḥ ..
sānukaṃpaṃ sulalitaṃ visphuṭārthapadākṣaram .. 44 ..
4.133.d:
उवाच वचनं पार्थ सुरसार्थस्य पश्यतः ॥
सानुकंपं सुललितं विस्फुटार्थपदाक्षरम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.133.m: O Pārtha, while the assembly of gods watched, he spoke words / full of compassion, very charming, with clear words, syllables, and meaning.

4.133.s:
śrīmahādeva uvāca ..
adya prabhṛti ye dolākrīḍāṃ puṣkariṇītaṭe ..
vasaṃte kārayiṣyaṃti maṃḍite tridaśāṃgaṇe .. 45 ..
4.133.d:
श्रीमहादेव उवाच ॥
अद्य प्रभृति ये दोलाक्रीडां पुष्करिणीतटे ॥
वसंते कारयिष्यंति मंडिते त्रिदशांगणे ॥ 45 ॥
4.133.m: The venerable Mahādeva said: / "From this day forward, those who, on the bank of a lotus pond, / in the courtyard of the gods decorated in spring, will celebrate the swing festival—

4.133.s:
netrapaṭṭāpaṭacchannāṃ padmarāgavibhūṣi tām ..
ātapatreṇa saṃyuktāṃ vinyastakanakāṃḍakām .. 46 ..
4.133.d:
नेत्रपट्टापटच्छन्नां पद्मरागविभूषि ताम् ॥
आतपत्रेण संयुक्तां विन्यस्तकनकांडकाम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.133.m: covered with silk cloths, adorned with rubies, / furnished with an umbrella, having golden finials placed upon it,

4.133.s:
vicitrābharaṇābhābhirābhāsitadigaṃtarām ..
tārakāśāṃtacitrāṃgapuṣpamālāmanora mām .. 47 ..
4.133.d:
विचित्राभरणाभाभिराभासितदिगंतराम् ॥
तारकाशांतचित्रांगपुष्पमालामनोर माम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.133.m: illuminating the directions with the luster of manifold ornaments, / delightful with flower garlands of various kinds resembling stars,

4.133.s:
mālāṃ vidyādharākrātāṃ prāṃtaropitadarpaṇām ..
chatracāmarasaṃchannāṃ yathā śaktyāpyalaṃkṛtām .. 48 ..
4.133.d:
मालां विद्याधराक्रातां प्रांतरोपितदर्पणाम् ॥
छत्रचामरसंछन्नां यथा शक्त्याप्यलंकृताम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.133.m: with a garland surrounded by Vidyādharas, with mirrors set at its borders, / covered with royal parasols and chowries, and adorned according to one's ability—

4.133.s:
agnikāryaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kṣiptvā caiva diśāṃ balim ..
tasyāmāropayeddevamiṣṭahṛṣṭajanāvṛtaḥ .. 49 ..
4.133.d:
अग्निकार्यं ततः कृत्वा क्षिप्त्वा चैव दिशां बलिम् ॥
तस्यामारोपयेद्देवमिष्टहृष्टजनावृतः ॥ 49 ॥
4.133.m: having then performed the fire-rite and cast the offering to the directions, / one should place the god upon it, surrounded by dear and joyful people.

4.133.s:
mūlamaṃtreṇa devānāṃ proktaṃ dolādhirohaṇam ..
pārśvastho brāhmaṇo vidvānpaṭhedvā maṃtramuttamam .. 4.133.50 ..
4.133.d:
मूलमंत्रेण देवानां प्रोक्तं दोलाधिरोहणम् ॥
पार्श्वस्थो ब्राह्मणो विद्वान्पठेद्वा मंत्रमुत्तमम् ॥ 4.133.50 ॥
4.133.m: The ascending of the swing by the gods is prescribed with the root mantra, / or a learned brāhmaṇa standing nearby should recite the supreme mantra.

4.133.s:
gaṃbhīrāṃtaranirghoṣairlalanānāṃ ca nisvanaiḥ ..
stutimaṃgalaśabdaiśca puṣpadhūpādhivāsitām .. 51 ..
4.133.d:
गंभीरांतरनिर्घोषैर्ललनानां च निस्वनैः ॥
स्तुतिमंगलशब्दैश्च पुष्पधूपाधिवासिताम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.133.m: With the deep, inner rumblings and sounds of women, / and with the words of auspicious hymns, perfumed with flowers and incense—

4.133.s:
etasminnantare nārīṃ dohanāya nikuṭṭakām ..
praveśayetkuṃkumāḍhyāṃ krīḍāvarṇapriyaiḥ saha .. 52 ..
4.133.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नारीं दोहनाय निकुट्टकाम् ॥
प्रवेशयेत्कुंकुमाढ्यां क्रीडावर्णप्रियैः सह ॥ 52 ॥
4.133.m: meanwhile, one should bring in a woman adorned with saffron to sprinkle [water], / dancing the nikuṭṭaka step, together with those who love colored sports.

4.133.s:
suvarṇaśṛṃgiṇā proktaṃ smitadaṃtāṃśukarburam ..
lagamānaṃ jalaṃ cāṃge kasya na syātsukhapradam .. 53 ..
4.133.d:
सुवर्णशृंगिणा प्रोक्तं स्मितदंतांशुकर्बुरम् ॥
लगमानं जलं चांगे कस्य न स्यात्सुखप्रदम् ॥ 53 ॥
4.133.m: Sprayed from a golden horn, variegated with the rays of smiling teeth, / to whom would the water striking the body not bring delight?

4.133.s:
jalasaṃklinnavasano raśanādāmamaṃḍitaḥ ..
kambugrīvollasansarvo babhūva gaṇikāgaṇaḥ .. 54 ..
4.133.d:
जलसंक्लिन्नवसनो रशनादाममंडितः ॥
कम्बुग्रीवोल्लसन्सर्वो बभूव गणिकागणः ॥ 54 ॥
4.133.m: Their garments drenched with water, adorned with girdle-strings, / the whole host of courtesans shone, their necks like conch shells.

4.133.s:
kuṃkumakṣodatāṃbūlapuṣpa mālākulo janaḥ ..
tāṃ vihāya jalakrīḍāṃ nānyasyāṃ vidadhe manaḥ .. 55 ..
4.133.d:
कुंकुमक्षोदतांबूलपुष्प मालाकुलो जनः ॥
तां विहाय जलक्रीडां नान्यस्यां विदधे मनः ॥ 55 ॥
4.133.m: Covered in saffron powder, betel, and flower garlands, / the people, setting aside that water sport, fixed their minds on nothing else.

4.133.s:
pītaśītajalāghāta tāḍito'pi janaḥ sukham ..
manyate niyataḥ kopi prabhāvo'yamanaṃgajaḥ .. 56 ..
4.133.d:
पीतशीतजलाघात ताडितोऽपि जनः सुखम् ॥
मन्यते नियतः कोपि प्रभावोऽयमनंगजः ॥ 56 ॥
4.133.m: Even when struck by the impact of yellow and cold water, the people considered it joy; / surely this was some power born of the Bodiless One.

4.133.s:
evaṃ ye tu gamiṣyaṃti narā vartmatayā gatam ..
nīrujaste bhaviṣyaṃti sukhitāḥ śaradāṃ śatam .. 57 ..
4.133.d:
एवं ये तु गमिष्यंति नरा वर्त्मतया गतम् ॥
नीरुजस्ते भविष्यंति सुखिताः शरदां शतम् ॥ 57 ॥
4.133.m: Those men who will thus proceed according to this path / will be free from disease and happy for a hundred autumns.

4.133.s:
putrapautrasamā yuktā dhanadhānyasamāyutāḥ ..
vihṛtya sukhasaṃpattau tato yāsyaṃti matpuram .. 58 ..
4.133.d:
पुत्रपौत्रसमा युक्ता धनधान्यसमायुताः ॥
विहृत्य सुखसंपत्तौ ततो यास्यंति मत्पुरम् ॥ 58 ॥
4.133.m: Endowed with sons and grandsons, accompanied by wealth and grain, / after sporting in prosperity and happiness, they will go to my city.

4.133.s:
prāpte vasaṃtasamaye surasattamānāmāndolanaṃ suravarānanukurvate ye ..
te prāpnuvaṃti bhuvi janmataroḥ phalāni duḥkhārṇavātkulaśatānyapi tārayaṃti .. 59 ..
damanakāṃdolakarathayātrāmahotsavavarṇanam
4.133.d:
प्राप्ते वसंतसमये सुरसत्तमानामान्दोलनं सुरवराननुकुर्वते ये ॥
ते प्राप्नुवंति भुवि जन्मतरोः फलानि दुःखार्णवात्कुलशतान्यपि तारयंति ॥ 59 ॥
दमनकांदोलकरथयात्रामहोत्सववर्णनम्
4.133.m:
When the spring season has arrived, those who imitate the gods' swinging / of the best of gods, obtain on earth the fruits of the tree of birth / and deliver even hundreds of families from the ocean of suffering."
Description of the great festival of Damanaka's swing and chariot procession.

4.134.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
rathayātrāvidhānaṃ te katha yāmi yudhiṣṭhira ..
sthiro bhūtvā nibodhedaṃ tvaṃ hi mūrtavidāṃ varaḥ .. 1 ..
4.134.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
रथयात्राविधानं ते कथ यामि युधिष्ठिर ॥
स्थिरो भूत्वा निबोधेदं त्वं हि मूर्तविदां वरः ॥ 1 ॥
4.134.m:
The blessed Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall explain to you the rite of the chariot procession, O Yudhiṣṭhira.
Become calm and learn this, for you are the foremost of those who know forms.

4.134.s:
caitre trinetrasaṃbhūtamalayākhyamahāgirau ..
pravahatpavanadhvānapreṃkholitalatācaye .. 2 ..
4.134.d:
चैत्रे त्रिनेत्रसंभूतमलयाख्यमहागिरौ ॥
प्रवहत्पवनध्वानप्रेंखोलितलताचये ॥ 2 ॥
4.134.m:
In the month of Caitra, on the great mountain named Malaya, which arose from the Three-Eyed Lord,
where clumps of creepers were set rocking by the sound of blowing winds,

4.134.s:
etasminneva kāle tu bhramamāṇo yadṛcchayā ..
nāradaḥ śāradākāṃtācchivaloke samāyayau .. 3 ..
4.134.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु भ्रममाणो यदृच्छया ॥
नारदः शारदाकांताच्छिवलोके समाययौ ॥ 3 ॥
4.134.m:
at that very time, wandering about at will,
Nārada arrived in the world of Śiva from [the presence of] his beloved Śāradā.

4.134.s:
dṛṣṭvāpūrvaṃ śivaṃ śāṃtaṃ sureśaiḥ sarvato vṛtam ..
praṇamyopāviśadvipraḥ purataḥ keśaveśayoḥ .. 4 ..
4.134.d:
दृष्ट्वापूर्वं शिवं शांतं सुरेशैः सर्वतो वृतम् ॥
प्रणम्योपाविशद्विप्रः पुरतः केशवेशयोः ॥ 4 ॥
4.134.m:
Seeing wondrous, tranquil Śiva surrounded on all sides by the lords of gods,
the Brahmin bowed and sat down before Keśava and the Lord.

4.134.s:
tamupāsīnamālakṣya bhagavānbhaganetrahā ..
papracchācchāditamanāḥ kutaścāgamyate punaḥ .. 5 ..
4.134.d:
तमुपासीनमालक्ष्य भगवान्भगनेत्रहा ॥
पप्रच्छाच्छादितमनाः कुतश्चागम्यते पुनः ॥ 5 ॥
4.134.m:
Observing him seated nearby, the blessed destroyer of Bhaga's eyes,
his mind veiled [in curiosity], asked: “Whence do you come now?”

4.134.s:
.. śrīnārada uvāca .. ..
śiva kāmaṃ ca taṃ viddhi dagdhaṃ mā vibudhottama ..
vasaṃto nāma ko'pyeṣa kāmasya dayitaḥ sakhā .. 6 ..
4.134.d:
॥ श्रीनारद उवाच ॥ ॥
शिव कामं च तं विद्धि दग्धं मा विबुधोत्तम ॥
वसंतो नाम कोऽप्येष कामस्य दयितः सखा ॥ 6 ॥
4.134.m:
The blessed Nārada said:
O Śiva, do not think that Kāma has been burnt up, O best of the gods!
There is a certain beloved friend of Kāma named Spring.

4.134.s:
malayānilayuktena tena viśvaṃ vaśīkṛtam ..
sahakārakarīndrasthaṃ kṛtvā kokilaḍiṃḍimam .. 7 ..
4.134.d:
मलयानिलयुक्तेन तेन विश्वं वशीकृतम् ॥
सहकारकरीन्द्रस्थं कृत्वा कोकिलडिंडिमम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.134.m:
Joined with the Malaya breeze, by him the universe has been subdued.
Placing the cuckoo-drum atop the lordly elephant of a mango tree,

4.134.s:
poṣayāmāsa vijayaṃ manmathasya purepure ..
śaśāṃkaśekharaḥ ko'yaṃ koyaṃ śaṃkhagadādharaḥ .. 8 ..
4.134.d:
पोषयामास विजयं मन्मथस्य पुरेपुरे ॥
शशांकशेखरः कोऽयं कोयं शंखगदाधरः ॥ 8 ॥
4.134.m:
he fostered the victory of the Love-god in every single city:
“Who is this Moon-crested Lord? Who is this wielder of the conch and mace?

4.134.s:
koyaṃ ca ḍimbo vā brahmā kāmastrijagatāṃ prabhuḥ ..
prāyaḥ krīḍāratirloko vasaṃtavacanātpunaḥ .. 9 ..
4.134.d:
कोयं च डिम्बो वा ब्रह्मा कामस्त्रिजगतां प्रभुः ॥
प्रायः क्रीडारतिर्लोको वसंतवचनात्पुनः ॥ 9 ॥
4.134.m:
Who is this mere child, or Brahmā? Kāma is the master of the three worlds!”
People are almost entirely devoted to pleasure on account of Spring's command.

4.134.s:
ūrdhvabāhustu narnarti tāladattapadakramaḥ ..
vyavasāyaṃ na gacchaṃti ye saṃhṛtya vanāṃtaram .. 4.134.10 ..
4.134.d:
ऊर्ध्वबाहुस्तु नर्नर्ति तालदत्तपदक्रमः ॥
व्यवसायं न गच्छंति ये संहृत्य वनांतरम् ॥ 4.134.10 ॥
4.134.m:
With upraised arms they dance, stepping in time to the rhythm.
Even those who had retired into the deep forest no longer engage in ascetic effort;

4.134.s:
gāyaṃtaśca parīhṛṣṭāste cāpyāyāṃti yāṃti ca ..
gopyasīmāṃtaragatāḥ kṣetrasthānasya rakṣiṇaḥ .. 11 ..
4.134.d:
गायंतश्च परीहृष्टास्ते चाप्यायांति यांति च ॥
गोप्यसीमांतरगताः क्षेत्रस्थानस्य रक्षिणः ॥ 11 ॥
4.134.m:
rejoicing and singing, they too come and go.
The guards of the fields, who have reached the boundary lands of the cowherdesses,

4.134.s:
te'pi gāyaṃti nṛtyaṃti hasaṃti smaratārakāḥ ..
karasya tāḍane'tyarthaṃ murajo dhurdharāyate .. 12 ..
4.134.d:
तेऽपि गायंति नृत्यंति हसंति स्मरतारकाः ॥
करस्य ताडनेऽत्यर्थं मुरजो धुर्धरायते ॥ 12 ॥
4.134.m:
they too sing, dance, and laugh, with eyes full of love.
Under the heavy beating of hands, the drum roars incessantly.

4.134.s:
viṭaṃ paśyaṃti kulaṭāḥ prārabdhocitapaṇḍitāḥ ..
sumanāṃsi susaṃgītanṛtyavādyasuvāditam .. 13 ..
4.134.d:
विटं पश्यंति कुलटाः प्रारब्धोचितपण्डिताः ॥
सुमनांसि सुसंगीतनृत्यवाद्यसुवादितम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.134.m:
Unchaste women gaze upon paramours, skilled in what is timely and initiated;
[their] minds delight in sweet singing, dancing, and the playing of musical instruments.

4.134.s:
evametattriloke'sminniti vyavasito janaḥ ..
lalallambastanīṃ dṛṣṭvā jarā yoṣāpi nṛtyati .. 14 ..
4.134.d:
एवमेतत्त्रिलोकेऽस्मिन्निति व्यवसितो जनः ॥
